| **How to check** | GET /api/kite/status -> using_live_data |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_kite_fallback_stall.py::test_rejected_kite_token_is_skipped_until_it_changes` |
| **Source** | README §43 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>DAT-02</code> <b>Active</b> — When Kite is down, data falls back to yfinance, which runs about 15 minutes delayed.</summary>

When Kite is down, data falls back to yfinance, which runs about 15 minutes delayed. Any Kite failure on candles or LTP falls back per call or per symbol, and yfinance candles are tagged delayed=True. A TokenException also marks the token rejected, so later calls skip Kite until a new token arrives.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Keep the engine and its stops running through a dead session (#23 cost 5h20m). |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/data_provider.py:get_intraday_candles, get_candles_batch, get_ltp, _note_kite_failure` |
| **How to check** | backend log 'Kite historical data failed for X (...); falling back to yfinance'; candles in /api/candles/{sym} carry delayed:true |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_fault_injection.py::test_candles_batch_kite_down_falls_back_to_yfinance_cleanly` |
| **Source** | README §43 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>DAT-03</code> <b>Active</b> — get_candles_batch never raises.</summary>

get_candles_batch never raises. A symbol whose fetch fails on every path is simply left out of the result, and the tick then handles each symbol on its own.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | One bad data call must not drop the whole tick. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/data_provider.py:get_candles_batch._safe_yfinance_batch` |
| **How to check** | Activity continues during a yfinance outage; per-symbol errors in /api/activity |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_fault_injection.py::test_candles_batch_kite_and_yfinance_both_down_returns_empty_not_raise` |
| **Source** | README §28 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>DAT-04</code> <b>Active</b> — Only one yfinance download() runs at a time in the whole process.</summary>

Only one yfinance download() runs at a time in the whole process. Waiting for the lock times out after 120 s with an error instead of blocking forever.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | yfinance's module-global result dict mixed up tickers between overlapping calls (the engine read another stock's candles). |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/data_provider.py:yf_download` |
| **Setting** | `_YF_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 120` |
| **How to check** | Backend log 'another yfinance download has been running for over 120s' on contention |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_kite_fallback_stall.py::test_yfinance_downloads_never_overlap` |
| **Source** | README §43 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>DAT-05</code> <b>Active</b> — Kite historical-data calls in the live batch fetch use at most 3 concurrent workers, with submissions after the third staggered by about 0.33 s.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Kite's historical endpoint allows about 3 requests per second; bursting causes 429s. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/data_provider.py:get_candles_batch` |
| **Setting** | `_KITE_HISTORICAL_MAX_WORKERS = 3` |
| **How to check** | Code read; absence of 429 warnings in backend log |
| **Source** | README §25 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>DAT-06</code> <b>Active</b> — A Kite session is live only until the next 06:00 IST after it was generated, not for 24 hours.</summary>

A Kite session is live only until the next 06:00 IST after it was generated, not for 24 hours. After that, kite_connected is false everywhere. A token from the environment with no generated_at is trusted until Kite rejects it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Zerodha invalidates every access token daily at 06:00 IST; the UI once claimed 'connected' for two days (§53). |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/data_provider.py:kite_token_expires_at, kite_session_live` |
| **Setting** | `KITE_TOKEN_EXPIRY_HOUR_IST = 6` |
| **How to check** | GET /api/kite/status -> state 'expired', expires_at, seconds_until_expiry; header chip |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_kite_session_status.py::test_expiry_is_the_next_6am_ist_not_24_hours_later` |
| **Source** | README §53 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>DAT-07</code> <b>Active</b> — /api/kite/status?probe=true confirms the session with kite.profile(), with a hard 4 s deadline on a daemon thread.</summary>

/api/kite/status?probe=true confirms the session with kite.profile(), with a hard 4 s deadline on a daemon thread. A TokenException reports 'expired' and marks the token rejected; any other failure or timeout reports 'error'.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The clock cannot see a token revoked from Zerodha's side, and a hung Kite must not hang the dashboard. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/data_provider.py:kite_session_status, _probe_kite` |
| **Setting** | `KITE_PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 4` |
| **How to check** | GET /api/kite/status?probe=true -> probed:true, state |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_kite_session_status.py::test_probe_gives_up_on_a_hanging_kite_without_hanging_the_request` |
| **Source** | README §53 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>DAT-08</code> <b>Active</b> — The newest candle is dropped until it has finished: real-time bars once their interval ends, and delayed (yfinance) bars only after the session close…</summary>

The newest candle is dropped until it has finished: real-time bars once their interval ends, and delayed (yfinance) bars only after the session close plus 30 minutes. The checklist and the scanner's relative volume read finished bars only.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | No decisions on a bar that is still forming (§42). |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/data_provider.py:closed_bars` |
| **Setting** | `_DELAYED_FEED_SETTLE = 30 min` |
| **How to check** | checklist_evals.bar_time lags ts by at least one bar |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_closed_bars.py::test_delayed_feed_newest_row_is_never_trusted_during_the_session` |
| **Source** | README §42 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>DAT-09</code> <b>Active</b> — Whole-exchange market breadth is stored as one row per session date (INSERT OR REPLACE) on every scan.</summary>

Whole-exchange market breadth is stored as one row per session date (INSERT OR REPLACE) on every scan. The McClellan Oscillator reports 'not enough data' until 39 days exist.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Oscillator history must not double-count re-scans of the same day. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/database.py:record_market_breadth, mcclellan_oscillator` |
| **How to check** | GET /api/market-breadth; SELECT count(\*) FROM market_breadth_daily |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_market_breadth.py::test_record_market_breadth_is_idempotent_per_day` |
| **Source** | README §20 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>DAT-10</code> <b>Active</b> — The Kite backtest cache fetches in 60-day windows, oldest first, at least 0.4 s apart through a process-wide limiter.</summary>

The Kite backtest cache fetches in 60-day windows, oldest first, at least 0.4 s apart through a process-wide limiter. It records every window it asked for, including empty ones, so interrupted pulls resume. --refresh re-fetches a symbol entirely so every bar carries the same dividend adjustment.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Deep history for backtests without being throttled, and without mixed dividend adjustments (#108). |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/kite_history.py:download_symbol, RateLimiter` |
| **Setting** | `CHUNK_DAYS = 60; MIN_SECONDS_BETWEEN_REQUESTS = 0.4` |
| **How to check** | python backend/kite_history.py --status -> fetch_runs |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_kite_history.py::test_an_interrupted_pull_resumes_where_it_stopped` |
| **Source** | README §50 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>DAT-11</code> <b>Active</b> — A missing fundamental metric (ROE, operating margin, D/E, positive PEG) is skipped, never guessed.</summary>

A missing fundamental metric (ROE, operating margin, D/E, positive PEG) is skipped, never guessed. With none available the score is None ('Not enough data'). Results are cached 24 h, and a Yahoo failure returns 'Not enough data' instead of raising.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Never fabricate a data point. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/fundamentals.py:get_fundamentals` |
| **Setting** | `CACHE_TTL_SECONDS = 86400` |
| **How to check** | /api/scanner rows brain.fundamentals (via trader_brain) label |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_fundamentals.py::test_missing_data_never_guessed` |
| **Source** | README §41 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>DAT-12</code> <b>Active</b> — Any two historical-data requests to Kite start at least 0.35 seconds apart, whichever part of the engine makes them.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Kite allows about three a second. The engine's tick and the scanner each paced their own batch; together they could send six. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/data_provider.py:_wait_for_kite_historical` |
| **How to check** | backend.log: no 'Too many requests' from Kite during a scan |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_scanner_live_feed.py::test_historical_requests_are_spaced_whoever_makes_them` |
| **Source** | README §101 |

</details>

## External services

Kite login, NSE, news, language models, alerts.

<details>
<summary><code>INT-01</code> <b>Active</b> — A Kite login that starts but gets no /kite/callback within 120 s is reported as stalled, with the registered redirect URL shown.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A mismatched or offline redirect URL used to fail silently ('the button did nothing'). |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/data_provider.py:kite_login_stalled` |
| **Setting** | `KITE_LOGIN_STALL_SECONDS = 120` |
| **How to check** | GET /api/kite/status -> login_stalled:true, reason names redirect_url |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_kite_session_status.py::test_a_login_that_never_returned_is_stalled` |
| **Source** | README §53 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>INT-02</code> <b>Active</b> — The ngrok tunnel is started only when a Kite login starts and is reused if one is already up.</summary>

The ngrok tunnel is started only when a Kite login starts and is reused if one is already up. It is stopped 5 s after /kite/callback, or after a 600 s backstop. An ngrok started by hand is never killed, and if the tunnel can't come up within 15 s no login is started (503).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Kite needs an HTTPS redirect, but the backend shouldn't stay on the internet. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/kite_tunnel.py:ensure_up, stop_soon; backend/app.py:kite_login_url, kite_callback` |
| **Setting** | `KITE_TUNNEL.enabled = True; start_timeout_s = 15; max_seconds = 600` |
| **How to check** | Backend log 'Kite login tunnel up at ...' then 'Kite login tunnel stopped'; curl 127.0.0.1:4040/api/tunnels |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_kite_tunnel.py::test_the_backstop_timer_stops_an_abandoned_login` |
| **Source** | README §62 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>INT-03</code> <b>Active</b> — A successful /kite/callback saves the new session, drops the cached Kite data client and order executor, and resets the alert backoff, so the new…</summary>

A successful /kite/callback saves the new session, drops the cached Kite data client and order executor, and resets the alert backoff, so the new token is used immediately without a restart.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The daily login must take effect instantly. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/app.py:kite_callback; backend/data_provider.py:reset_kite_client; backend/trading_engine.py:reset_kite_executor` |
| **How to check** | activity 'Kite connected — real-time data and live order routing available'; /api/kite/status state connected |
| **Source** | README §53, §62 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>INT-04</code> <b>Active</b> — NSE website endpoints are called with browser headers after priming cookies, and each response is cached: announcements 10 min, calendar and…</summary>

NSE website endpoints are called with browser headers after priming cookies, and each response is cached: announcements 10 min, calendar and corporate actions 6 h, deals and FII/DII 1 h, breadth 5 min. On failure the last good payload or None is returned, and the scan continues.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | These are undocumented and anti-bot protected, and can change or rate-limit without notice. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/nse_feed.py:_fetch` |
| **How to check** | backend log 'NSE /api/... unavailable (HTTP 403)'; scan still completes |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_fault_injection.py::test_fii_dii_flows_survives_nse_timeout` |
| **Source** | README §20 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>INT-05</code> <b>Active</b> — Per-stock news sentiment is cached 15 minutes.</summary>

Per-stock news sentiment is cached 15 minutes. Headlines are de-duplicated and dropped after 72 h, and non-trusted headlines must name the company. Each is weighted by source trust (NSE 1.5, Marketaux 1.2, Alpha Vantage 1.2, Google 1.0, Yahoo 0.6) and a 12 h half-life, then scaled by evidence mass. Yahoo is queried only when Google returned nothing.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | One stale or off-topic headline must not dominate. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/news_sentiment.py:_aggregate, get_sentiment` |
| **Setting** | `NEWS.use_nse_filings = True; use_google_news = True; use_yahoo = True` |
| **How to check** | GET /api/news/{symbol} -> score, headlines[].source/age_h, sources |
| **Source** | README §10 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>INT-06</code> <b>Active</b> — Paid or limited external APIs have in-memory daily call budgets that reset at the UTC date: Marketaux 90, Alpha Vantage 20, LLM headline sentiment…</summary>

Paid or limited external APIs have in-memory daily call budgets that reset at the UTC date: Marketaux 90, Alpha Vantage 20, LLM headline sentiment 500, Chaywanaprash 12. Past the budget, the source is skipped and the fallback is used.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Stay inside free tiers and cap LLM spend. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/news_sentiment.py:_marketaux_allowed, _alphavantage_allowed; backend/llm_sentiment.py:_allowed; backend/chaywanaprash.py:_allowed` |
| **Setting** | `NEWS.marketaux_daily_limit = 90; NEWS.alphavantage_daily_limit = 20; NEWS.llm_daily_limit = 500; CHAYWANAPRASH.daily_limit = 12` |
| **How to check** | GET /api/llm-sentiment/status used_today; GET /api/chaywanaprash/status |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_chaywanaprash.py::test_analyze_respects_daily_budget` |
| **Source** | README §12, §29 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>INT-07</code> <b>Active</b> — LLM headline scoring (Claude Haiku 4.5) falls back to the keyword lexicon on any error, missing key, disabled toggle or spent budget, and caches each…</summary>

LLM headline scoring (Claude Haiku 4.5) falls back to the keyword lexicon on any error, missing key, disabled toggle or spent budget, and caches each headline's score permanently. It is off by default, even with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set: only the dashboard switch (POST /api/llm-sentiment/enable) or NEWS.use_llm_sentiment set by hand turns it on. The switch's position is saved in the journal's control table and read back at start-up.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | LLM reading must never block a scan or checklist read. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/llm_sentiment.py:score_headline; backend/llm_sentiment.py:set_enabled; backend/llm_sentiment.py:restore_saved_choice; backend/config.py NEWS.use_llm_sentiment` |
| **Setting** | `NEWS.use_llm_sentiment = False; control key llm_sentiment_enabled once the switch is used; NEWS.llm_daily_limit = 500` |
| **How to check** | GET /api/llm-sentiment/status enabled/configured; /api/news/{sym} headlines[].llm_scored; control table row llm_sentiment_enabled |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_llm_sentiment_default.py::test_a_key_alone_does_not_turn_headline_scoring_on; backend/tests/test_llm_sentiment_default.py::test_the_switch_is_saved_and_a_restart_keeps_it` |
| **Source** | README §12, §114 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>INT-08</code> <b>Active</b> — Chaywanaprash is read-only.</summary>

Chaywanaprash is read-only. It always returns the real computed journal stats, and adds an LLM narrative only when an LLM is available and today's budget allows: the Anthropic API when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, otherwise the Claude Code CLI with every tool, hook and MCP server switched off. In 'auto' the CLI is also the fallback when the API call fails. It runs when asked, and once a week on its own as the fortnightly review (INT-10). Every run, with or without the LLM, is saved to chaywanaprash_reports.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Never fabricate a narrative; a human decides on every change. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/chaywanaprash.py:analyze; backend/chaywanaprash.py:backends; backend/chaywanaprash.py:_ask_cli` |
| **Setting** | `CHAYWANAPRASH.enabled = True; llm_backend = 'auto'; daily_limit = 12; lookback_hours = 24` |
| **How to check** | GET /api/chaywanaprash/status lists the backends a run would use; POST /api/chaywanaprash/analyze saves one report |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_chaywanaprash.py::test_cli_is_used_when_there_is_no_api_key; backend/tests/test_llm_sentiment_default.py::test_chaywanaprash_does_not_follow_the_key` |
| **Source** | README §29, §92 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>INT-09</code> <b>Off by default</b> — Telegram receives only actionable activity lines, prefixed [PAPER] or [LIVE]: kinds trade, error, risk, summary and momentum (the momentum book's…</summary>

Telegram receives only actionable activity lines, prefixed [PAPER] or [LIVE]: kinds trade, error, risk, summary and momentum (the momentum book's rebalances and evening-job failures, MOM-16); any trade- or error-level line; and warn-level system or review lines. The same text is sent at most once per 30 minutes, at most 20 messages per minute, from a background queue that never blocks the engine. The on/off setting persists in the control table.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A phone alert channel for an unattended engine, without spam. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/telegram_alerts.py:wants, enqueue, _run; backend/state.py:log; backend/app.py:set_telegram_enabled` |
| **Setting** | `DEDUPE_SECONDS = 1800; MAX_PER_MINUTE = 20` |
| **How to check** | GET /api/alerts/telegram shows configured, enabled and the last error; POST /api/alerts/telegram/test sends one test message |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_telegram_alerts.py::test_only_actionable_lines_are_sent` |
| **Source** | README §66, §116 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>INT-10</code> <b>Active</b> — Chaywanaprash's fortnightly review runs after the close on a trading day, at most once a day, only when no 14-day report with a narrative is under a…</summary>

Chaywanaprash's fortnightly review runs after the close on a trading day, at most once a day, only when no 14-day report with a narrative is under a week old. It reads 14 days of the journal, every change merged in that time and the trading rules as they stand, and proposes at most five improvements, each with the test that must pass before it ships. It runs off the tick thread and changes nothing.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The rules change fast; a standing review checks each change against what the journal shows, without letting an LLM edit the decision logic. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/chaywanaprash.py:review_due; backend/chaywanaprash.py:maybe_start_review; backend/trading_engine.py:_tick_impl` |
| **Setting** | `CHAYWANAPRASH.review_every_days = 7 (0 turns it off); review_lookback_days = 14; review_after = '15:40'` |
| **How to check** | After the close, the activity log shows 'Chaywanaprash: reviewing the last two weeks' and then 'the review of the last 14 days is saved'; GET /api/chaywanaprash/reports shows a report with lookback_hours 336 |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_chaywanaprash.py::test_review_runs_off_the_tick_thread_and_logs_the_outcome` |
| **Source** | README §95 |

</details>

## Momentum book

The paper run of the one strategy that passed.

<details>
<summary><code>MOM-01</code> <b>Paper only</b> — The momentum book is paper only: it holds positions in a JSON state file and places no order through any broker.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The 3i strategy has to pass a forward paper run before real money is considered. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/momentum_book.py (module docstring; it imports no broker)` |
| **Setting** | `MOMENTUM_BOOK.capital = 1000000.0` |
| **How to check** | grep momentum_book.py for kite_broker/paper_broker (none); Momentum Book page says 'Paper only' |
| **Source** | README §83 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>MOM-02</code> <b>Active</b> — The momentum universe is the 200 stocks with the highest median traded value over 126 sessions, with at least 250 sessions of history, a raw close of…</summary>

The momentum universe is the 200 stocks with the highest median traded value over 126 sessions, with at least 250 sessions of history, a raw close of at least Rs 20, and a print in the EQ series on the ranking day. It is chosen from EQ rows only: a stock in trade-for-trade that day is not eligible, and its trade-for-trade days count as days without a trade.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Fixes the tradable, liquid universe exactly as pre-registered. Reading trade-for-trade rows for prices (MOM-14) must not change which stocks are eligible. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/momentum_book.py:ranked_universe` |
| **Setting** | `MOMENTUM_BOOK.universe = 200` |
| **How to check** | python momentum_book.py summary; holdings are all large-turnover names |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_momentum_book.py::test_the_universe_is_chosen_from_eq_rows_as_research_does` |
| **Source** | docs/research/prereg-3i-momentum-corrected-data.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>MOM-03</code> <b>Active</b> — Fund units and ETFs are excluded from the panel: any ISIN starting INF, any symbol in eq_etfseclist.csv, or any name ending BEES/ETF/IETF/CASE.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | 3i ranks operating companies only; fund units distorted earlier tests. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/momentum_book.py:build_panel` |
| **How to check** | No ETF ever appears in Momentum Book holdings |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_momentum_book.py::test_price_adjustment_matches_research` |
| **Source** | README §82 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>MOM-04</code> <b>Active</b> — Rank by mean(r6/sigma, r12/sigma), with returns measured to the previous month-end (skip-month) and sigma the population std of up to 252 daily…</summary>

Rank by mean(r6/sigma, r12/sigma), with returns measured to the previous month-end (skip-month) and sigma the population std of up to 252 daily total-return changes. A stock needs at least 60 returns, and the panel needs at least 14 month-ends.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The exact pre-registered volatility-adjusted momentum score. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/momentum_book.py:scores` |
| **How to check** | Parity test against research/momentum_3i.py |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_momentum_book.py::test_ranking_matches_research` |
| **Source** | README §82 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>MOM-05</code> <b>Active</b> — Hold 15 names.</summary>

Hold 15 names. Keep a holding while it ranks in the top 30; sell it if it leaves the universe, has no EQ print at the month-end, or ranks below 30; fill the empty slots from the top of the ranking. A holding whose sell is waiting still counts as held, so it takes a slot until it is sold.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The pre-registered buffer cuts turnover and costs. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/momentum_book.py:rebalance` |
| **Setting** | `MOMENTUM_BOOK.hold = 15; MOMENTUM_BOOK.rank_keep = 30` |
| **How to check** | Momentum Book page holdings count (15 once active) and Recent trades |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_momentum_book.py::test_book_rebalances_on_the_first_session_of_each_month_and_marks_daily` |
| **Source** | README §83 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>MOM-06</code> <b>Active</b> — Rebalance only on the first session of a month, ranking at the previous (month-end) close and ordering for that first session's close, and only if…</summary>

Rebalance only on the first session of a month, ranking at the previous (month-end) close and ordering for that first session's close, and only if the book had already processed the month-end session. Sells that can fill are filled first; each buy's amount is fixed that day as cash over vacancies.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Prevents look-ahead and retroactive trades from before the book existed. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/momentum_book.py:process_session and rebalance` |
| **How to check** | state.trades: every trade's date, or its 'ordered' date if it waited, is the first session of a month; the first rebalance is ordered for the 1 Oct 2026 close |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_momentum_book.py::test_book_does_not_rebalance_on_months_before_it_existed` |
| **Source** | README §83 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>MOM-07</code> <b>Active</b> — Every book trade pays Zerodha delivery costs (STT 0.10% on each side, stamp 0.015% on buys, NSE txn 0.00307%, SEBI 0.0001%, GST 18% on txn+SEBI) plus…</summary>

Every book trade pays Zerodha delivery costs (STT 0.10% on each side, stamp 0.015% on buys, NSE txn 0.00307%, SEBI 0.0001%, GST 18% on txn+SEBI) plus 0.05% slippage per leg and Rs 15.34 DP on each book sell.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The result must be net of every real charge to mean anything. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/momentum_book.py:buy_cost/sell_cost` |
| **Setting** | `MOMENTUM_BOOK.slippage = 0.0005` |
| **How to check** | Momentum Book page 'Charges and slippage' column; state.trades[].cost |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_momentum_book.py::test_book_rebalances_on_the_first_session_of_each_month_and_marks_daily` |
| **Source** | README §83 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>MOM-08</code> <b>Active</b> — The benchmark is the same 200-stock universe, equal-weighted at the first rebalance and afterwards updated only for leavers and entrants.</summary>

The benchmark is the same 200-stock universe, equal-weighted at the first rebalance and afterwards updated only for leavers and entrants. It pays the same costs except the DP charge.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Excess must be measured against the strategy's own universe. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/momentum_book.py:process_session` |
| **How to check** | Momentum Book page 'Benchmark value' and the dashed NAV line |
| **Source** | README §83 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>MOM-09</code> <b>Active</b> — Switch-off band: once there are 6 or more months of excess, the book switches itself off if cumulative net excess falls below n*0.71% -…</summary>

Switch-off band: once there are 6 or more months of excess, the book switches itself off if cumulative net excess falls below n\*0.71% - 2\*3.89%\*sqrt(n), which is -14.8% at 6 months and -18.4% at 12. The two figures are trial 126's. They were 0.82% and 3.87%, trial 120's, until the owner's decision of 2026-09-29, made before the book's first rebalance.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The forward band was fixed before the book started, so failure is automatic and not a judgment call. The book runs trial 126's configuration, so the band expects what trial 126 measured. The change loosens the floor by 0.8 points at 6 months. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/momentum_book.py:process_session and band_threshold` |
| **Setting** | `MOMENTUM_BOOK.expected_monthly_excess = 0.0071; MOMENTUM_BOOK.monthly_excess_sd = 0.0389; MOMENTUM_BOOK.band_from_month = 6` |
| **How to check** | Momentum Book page 'Switch-off floor now'; state.band_floor and status_reason |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_momentum_book.py::test_the_band_uses_trial_126s_figures` |
| **Source** | docs/research/results-universe-width.md; docs/research/prereg-3i-momentum-corrected-data.md (notes on the forward paper book); README §99 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>MOM-10</code> <b>Active</b> — Once switched off, the momentum book stops processing: no more trades, and the NAV freezes.</summary>

Once switched off, the momentum book stops processing: no more trades, and the NAV freezes. No code path turns it back on, and the engine no longer starts the evening job for it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A failed forward test must not quietly resume. The frozen record never reaches today, so the job used to be started again every 30 minutes, every evening (#227). |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/momentum_book.py:process_session and maybe_start_evening_job` |
| **How to check** | state.status == 'switched_off' and nav[-1].date stops advancing |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_momentum_book.py::test_book_switches_itself_off_below_the_band; backend/tests/test_momentum_book_data.py::test_a_switched_off_book_does_not_rerun_the_job_every_half_hour` |
| **Source** | README §83 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>MOM-11</code> <b>Active</b> — Prices come from NSE's daily bhavcopies, adjusted with NSE's own corporate-actions file (splits, bonuses, consolidations, rights at TERP, demergers…</summary>

Prices come from NSE's daily bhavcopies, adjusted with NSE's own corporate-actions file (splits, bonuses, consolidations, rights at TERP, demergers, dividends) into total-return closes, and positions are valued by total-return ratio from the fill date. A dividend is read without face values or bracketed remarks, and is applied when it is below the previous close. A demerger is applied when it leaves between 1% and 98% of the price. A failed refresh of the corporate-actions file is logged as a warning, and the Momentum Book page shows the date of the file in use and says when the last refresh failed. The weekly refresh of NSE's symbol-change file is recorded the same way: a failure is logged as a warning, and state.data keeps whether the last refresh worked and the file's date.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The uncorrected data had produced false signals (the reason for 3i). Consolidations, seven dividend amounts and two real actions outside the old bounds were wrong until 2026-09-28 (#177, #178). A refresh that failed was silent, and a split it missed would show as a price drop (#159). The symbol-change refresh failed silently (#220). |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/momentum_book.py:build_panel, value_of and daily` |
| **How to check** | Parity test against the repaired panel of research/nse_prices.py; on the real cache the two panels have 0 differences; the page footer 'corporate-actions file from ...'; state.data.corporate_actions_refreshed; state.data.symbol_changes_refreshed and symbol_changes_as_of |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_momentum_book.py::test_the_panel_is_the_research_loaders_repaired_panel; backend/tests/test_momentum_book_data.py::test_the_symbol_change_refresh_is_recorded_and_a_failure_is_logged` |
| **Source** | README §82, §97, §113 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>MOM-12</code> <b>Active</b> — The momentum evening job starts only on weekdays that are not holidays, between 19:30 and 23:30 IST.</summary>

The momentum evening job starts only on weekdays that are not holidays, between 19:30 and 23:30 IST. It runs as a separate child process, retries every 30 minutes until today's session is processed, and never runs two copies at once, also across an engine restart: the job holds a lock beside the state file (with its pid), the engine starts no job while it is held, and a job that finds it held exits 5 and does nothing.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The bhavcopy is published in the evening, and the heavy panel build must never share the trading process. An engine restarted in the evening forgot the job it had started, and a second job would have written the same state file (logic review, 2026-10-04). |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/momentum_book.py:maybe_start_evening_job, job_running and daily; called from backend/trading_engine.py:_tick_impl` |
| **Setting** | `MOMENTUM_BOOK.job_after = '19:30'; MOMENTUM_BOOK.job_until = '23:30'; MOMENTUM_BOOK.retry_minutes = 30; MOMENTUM_BOOK.enabled = True` |
| **How to check** | Activity log line 'Momentum book: evening job started'; backend/data/momentum_book.log; backend/data/momentum_book_state.json.lock holds the running job's pid |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_momentum_book.py::test_evening_job_starts_once_after_the_close_and_retries_later; backend/tests/test_momentum_book_data.py::test_a_second_evening_job_does_not_run_beside_one_still_running` |
| **Source** | README §83 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>MOM-13</code> <b>Active</b> — The evening job exits with code 3 when today's bhavcopy isn't published yet, 4 when its data is incomplete, 5 when another job is running, and 0 once…</summary>

The evening job exits with code 3 when today's bhavcopy isn't published yet, 4 when its data is incomplete, 5 when another job is running, and 0 once today's session is processed. Evenings it missed are caught up in order on the next run. Each run asks NSE again for every day of the last 31 without a bhavcopy (a 404 means no session that day), and for any older day whose download failed and has not come in since: those days are kept in state.data.failed_days_pending until the file arrives, NSE answers 404, or the owner clears one (momentum_book.py clear-failed-day). A download is written to a .part file and moved into place only once it is a valid zip, and only a valid zip counts as cached. A bhavcopy the panel cannot read is deleted and fetched again; until it is in, the book processes nothing. The book stops before a past day whose download failed, before a session on which a holding or open order has no price history, and before a month turn whose ranking comes out empty, keeping the sessions before it, until a later run has the data. The reason is kept in state.data.problem and shown on the page.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A Mac asleep, a late NSE file or a failed download must not lose a session or a month turn, or move a fill to a later day. The job used to start at the day after the newest file, so a day that failed was never fetched again, and an empty ranking skipped the month's rebalance (#159). A download cut off part-way was taken as cached for ever and its day dropped without a word (#262); a day that kept failing was dropped once it left the 31-day window (#220); a holding with no chain was valued and sold at its cost (#261). |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/momentum_book.py:daily, update_bhavcopies, download_bhavcopy, cached_dates, build_panel and process_session` |
| **How to check** | momentum_book.log lines 'daily done code=N' and any warning before them; state.last_processed advances; state.data.problem is null; the Momentum Book page shows no 'stopped early' line |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_momentum_book_data.py::test_the_book_waits_at_a_day_whose_download_failed; backend/tests/test_momentum_book_data.py::test_a_day_that_failed_is_fetched_again_after_a_later_day_succeeded; backend/tests/test_momentum_book_data.py::test_an_empty_month_end_ranking_stops_the_job_and_leaves_the_book_as_it_was; backend/tests/test_momentum_book.py::test_evening_job_is_skipped_once_today_is_processed; backend/tests/test_momentum_book_data.py::test_a_download_cut_off_part_way_never_looks_cached; backend/tests/test_momentum_book_data.py::test_a_half_written_bhavcopy_stops_the_job_and_is_fetched_again; backend/tests/test_momentum_book_data.py::test_a_day_that_keeps_failing_still_stops_the_book_after_it_leaves_the_window; backend/tests/test_momentum_book_data.py::test_a_holding_with_no_chain_and_no_symbol_change_stops_the_job` |
| **Source** | README §83, §113; docs/research/prereg-3i-momentum-corrected-data.md (third note on the forward paper book); README §123 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>MOM-14</code> <b>Active</b> — The price panel reads the EQ, BE and BZ series.</summary>

The price panel reads the EQ, BE and BZ series. A holding that moves to trade-for-trade is valued and sold at the price it traded for, not at its last EQ close. When a symbol has more than one of these series on a day, the EQ row is used.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Read from EQ alone, a holding in trade-for-trade kept a stale price and was sold at it, and 743 corporate actions were applied with a different factor (#175). |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/momentum_book.py:parse_bhavcopy and build_panel` |
| **How to check** | On the real bhavcopy cache the book's panel equals the research loader's repaired panel row for row (0 differences, 2026-09-28) |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_momentum_book.py::test_a_holding_in_trade_for_trade_is_valued_and_sold_at_what_it_traded_for` |
| **Source** | README §97; docs/research/results-universe-width.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>MOM-15</code> <b>Active</b> — An order fills at the fill day's close unless the stock did not trade that day, or closed locked against the order: a buy at its upper price band, a…</summary>

An order fills at the fill day's close unless the stock did not trade that day, or closed locked against the order: a buy at its upper price band, a sell at its lower. An order that cannot fill waits and is tried again each session. A buy that has waited five sessions is cancelled and its cash stays uninvested until the next rebalance. A sell waits until it fills. Orders still open at the next month-end are dropped and decided again.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A close at a locked band is not a price an order could have had. These are the fill rules of trial 126, the configuration that was tested on repaired prices. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/momentum_book.py:lock, why_not, work_orders and rebalance` |
| **Setting** | `BUY_CARRY = 5; BANDS = 2%, 5%, 10%, 20%` |
| **How to check** | Momentum Book page: 'Orders waiting', and the Note column of Recent trades. Run over 2010 to 2025 the book equals trial 126 month by month (largest difference 7e-16) |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_momentum_book.py::test_the_book_is_trial_126s_simulator_month_by_month` |
| **Source** | docs/research/prereg-universe-width.md (rules H1 to H5); README §99 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>MOM-16</code> <b>Active</b> — After the evening job, the engine says what it did, once.</summary>

After the evening job, the engine says what it did, once. Each rebalance the job completed gets one activity line of kind 'momentum': the month, the stocks bought and sold (and any order still waiting), the book against its benchmark for the month just ended and since the start, the band, and the next rebalance date. A run that failed (an exit code other than 0, 3, 4 or 5, or a signal) or stopped early (exit 4, state.data.problem) gets one line with the reason, once per reason a day. A weekday whose session is still not processed at 23:30, after a run that day, gets one line. Telegram sends every such line when it is set up and switched on (INT-09). What was alerted is kept in backend/data/momentum_book_alerts.json, written only by the engine, so a restart neither repeats an alert nor loses one; with no record, only the latest rebalance is alerted. The check runs after maybe_start_evening_job on each closed-phase tick, never raises, and never writes the book's state or starts or stops the job.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The book trades once a month in the evening, when nobody is watching the dashboard. The owner's decision of 2026-09-30 asked for an alert at each rebalance and when the job fails. The rebalance alert reads the state file's month points, not the job's process handle, because a restart loses the handle. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/momentum_alerts.py:check, _check, rebalance_message; called from backend/trading_engine.py:_tick_impl; backend/telegram_alerts.py:wants` |
| **Setting** | `KIND = 'momentum'; MOMENTUM_BOOK.job_until = '23:30'` |
| **How to check** | Activity log kind 'momentum' (the Live log shows it as 'Momentum book') after the rebalance of the first session of a month; backend/data/momentum_book_alerts.json 'rebalance' holds that date; GET /api/alerts/telegram |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_momentum_alerts.py::test_a_completed_rebalance_logs_one_line_and_sends_one_message; backend/tests/test_momentum_alerts.py::test_a_restart_does_not_repeat_a_rebalance_alert; backend/tests/test_momentum_alerts.py::test_a_rebalance_made_while_the_engine_was_down_is_alerted_once_after_the_restart; backend/tests/test_momentum_alerts.py::test_a_failed_run_is_alerted_once_with_its_reason; backend/tests/test_momentum_alerts.py::test_a_run_that_stopped_early_is_alerted_once_even_across_a_restart; backend/tests/test_momentum_alerts.py::test_the_engine_starts_the_job_before_the_check_and_a_failing_check_does_not_stop_it` |
| **Source** | README §116; docs/research/decisions/decision-2026-09-30-momentum-core.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>MOM-17</code> <b>Active</b> — The monthly report is read-only: it is recomputed from the month points and trades the job saved.</summary>

The monthly report is read-only: it is recomputed from the month points and trades the job saved. A month runs from one rebalance close to the next; its return is net of every trade inside it, including the rebalance that closes it, and its turnover ((bought + sold) / 2 / the book's value at the start) and costs count the same trades. Excess and cumulative excess are the band's own figures, summed as process_session sums them. The opening rebalance belongs to no month. The month under way is shown apart and not counted. Before the first month completes the report has no row and says so. The next rebalance is the first session of the month after the last session processed (weekends and NSE holidays skipped; flagged when the year has no holiday list).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The owner's decision of 2026-09-30 asked for a monthly report against the benchmark. Zeros shown before any month exists would read as results. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/momentum_book.py:monthly_report, band_status, next_rebalance and summary; frontend/src/pages/MomentumBook.jsx:MonthlyReport` |
| **How to check** | GET /api/momentum-book: months, opening_rebalance, band, month_to_date, next_rebalance; the front page's 'Month by month against the benchmark' |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_momentum_alerts.py::test_the_monthly_report_is_the_bands_own_arithmetic; backend/tests/test_momentum_alerts.py::test_before_month_one_the_report_has_no_month; backend/tests/test_momentum_alerts.py::test_the_next_rebalance_is_the_first_session_of_the_next_month` |
| **Source** | README §116 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>MOM-18</code> <b>Active</b> — A holding or open order follows its stock through an NSE symbol change.</summary>

A holding or open order follows its stock through an NSE symbol change. build_panel names each chain by the symbol's latest name in NSE's symbol-change file (rows with one ISIN stay in one chain) and reports where every symbol went; before processing, the evening job re-keys any holding or order whose symbol is no longer a chain to that chain, and keeps each change in state.symbol_changes. A holding is never valued or sold at its cost because its chain is missing: if no symbol change explains it, the job stops (exit 4).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A held stock renamed by NSE (ZOMATO to ETERNAL, 2025-04-09) lost its chain once the weekly file learnt the change, and was then valued at its cost and sold at its cost at the next month turn: 37 benchmark holdings and 1 book holding in a replay of 2010-2025 (#261). The research simulator holds final symbols, so its figures were never affected. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/momentum_book.py:build_panel, follow_symbol_changes, missing_chains and process_session` |
| **How to check** | state.symbol_changes lists each re-key; a holding's bought_as keeps the symbol it was bought under |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_momentum_book_data.py::test_a_holding_whose_symbol_changes_follows_its_chain_and_is_sold_at_its_price; backend/tests/test_momentum_book_data.py::test_build_panel_reports_the_chain_a_renamed_symbol_went_into; backend/tests/test_momentum_book_data.py::test_a_holding_with_no_chain_and_no_symbol_change_stops_the_job` |
| **Source** | README §123 |

</details>

## Jev book

The paper test of an LLM judge on the daily shortlist.

<details>
<summary><code>JEV-01</code> <b>Paper only</b> — The Jev book is paper only.</summary>

The Jev book is paper only. Jev sees only public market data (scanner row fields, chart labels, headlines, market summary, time, exit rule, cost), never keys, account data or positions.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | It is an evaluation of judgment, not a trading or data-exposure path. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/jev_book.py:build_state` |
| **How to check** | state.days[\*].decisions[\*].state in jev_book_state.json contains only market fields |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_jev_book.py::test_one_official_request_per_stock_then_close_scores_jev_and_the_scanner` |
| **Source** | README §86; docs/research/prereg-jev-book.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>JEV-02</code> <b>Active</b> — A Jev round starts once per trading day at the first open-phase tick at or after 09:45 IST, and only if the scanner has a same-day non-empty active…</summary>

A Jev round starts once per trading day at the first open-phase tick at or after 09:45 IST, and only if the scanner has a same-day non-empty active shortlist. A day already recorded, even as skipped, is never re-run.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | One pre-registered decision time a day, with no retry that would let the outcome choose the sample. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/jev_book.py:maybe_decide; backend/trading_engine.py:_tick_impl` |
| **Setting** | `JEV_BOOK.decide_at = '09:45'; JEV_BOOK.enabled = True` |
| **How to check** | Activity log 'Jev book: asking Jev about today's shortlist'; asked_at timestamps |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_jev_book.py::test_maybe_decide_gates` |
| **Source** | docs/research/prereg-jev-book.md (Protocol) |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>JEV-03</code> <b>Active</b> — Jev is asked about at most the first 15 stocks on the scanner's active list, in scanner order.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The pre-registered shortlist size. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/jev_book.py:decide_round` |
| **Setting** | `JEV_BOOK.max_names = 15` |
| **How to check** | Jev Book page latest-session table has at most 15 rows |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_jev_book.py::test_one_official_request_per_stock_then_close_scores_jev_and_the_scanner` |
| **Source** | docs/research/prereg-jev-book.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>JEV-04</code> <b>Active</b> — Each stock gets one request to TypeSafe's official System One API with three typed questions: action (buy, short or skip), p_up (the probability the…</summary>

Each stock gets one request to TypeSafe's official System One API with three typed questions: action (buy, short or skip), p_up (the probability the price is higher at 15:08) and size (none, half, normal or double).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Fixed question wording, and one call per stock keeps cost around \$0.03 a month. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/jev_book.py:questions and system_one` |
| **Setting** | `JEV_BOOK.endpoint = 'https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone'; JEV_BOOK.model = 'jev-latest'; JEV_BOOK.timeout_s = 90` |
| **How to check** | summary().input_tokens; decisions[].usage |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_jev_book.py::test_one_official_request_per_stock_then_close_scores_jev_and_the_scanner` |
| **Source** | docs/research/prereg-jev-book.md (Clarification 2) |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>JEV-05</code> <b>Active</b> — TypeSafe calls retry HTTP 429, 529, 5xx and connection errors with backoff of max(retry-after, 2^attempt) seconds, up to 4 attempts.</summary>

TypeSafe calls retry HTTP 429, 529, 5xx and connection errors with backoff of max(retry-after, 2^attempt) seconds, up to 4 attempts. HTTP 401, 403 and 422 are not retried.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Follows TypeSafe's API guidance without hammering it with a bad key. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/jev_book.py:system_one` |
| **Setting** | `jev_book.DEFAULTS.max_attempts = 4 (not overridden in config)` |
| **How to check** | day.error text on the Jev Book page |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_jev_book.py::test_rejected_key_is_not_retried` |
| **Source** | README §86 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>JEV-06</code> <b>Active</b> — If Jev can't be reached, or no key is stored, before any stock of the day has been decided, the day is recorded as 'jev_unavailable' with the error…</summary>

If Jev can't be reached, or no key is stored, before any stock of the day has been decided, the day is recorded as 'jev_unavailable' with the error and nothing is traded. If it fails after some stocks were decided, the round stops there: the day stays open with the decisions made so far, they close at the square-off like any other round, and the stop is recorded under 'interrupted' (the time, the error and the stocks not asked).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A missing judge must not be scored as a skip. Positions already opened at a live price must close and count: marked 'Jev unavailable', they were never closed (#158). |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/jev_book.py:decide_round and _stop_round` |
| **How to check** | Jev Book page 'Jev unavailable' pill and error; for a round stopped part-way, the line 'Today's round stopped after N of M stocks'; state days[date].interrupted; typesafe_key.py status |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_jev_book.py::test_no_key_records_unavailable_and_trades_nothing; backend/tests/test_jev_book.py::test_a_round_typesafe_interrupts_keeps_its_decisions_and_closes_them` |
| **Source** | README §86, §113; docs/research/prereg-jev-book.md (Clarification 9) |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>JEV-07</code> <b>Active</b> — Kite-only fills: Jev entries and exits come only from Kite's live last traded price (live_ltp), never from the delayed yfinance fallback, and only…</summary>

Kite-only fills: Jev entries and exits come only from Kite's live last traded price (live_ltp), never from the delayed yfinance fallback, and only while the Kite session is alive (kite_live: a stored token Kite has not rejected, before its 06:00 IST expiry). The live mark uses the same check.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A delayed fill against live headlines would leak information in Jev's favour (#151). |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/jev_book.py:live_ltp and kite_live; maybe_decide passes live_ltp; maybe_close` |
| **How to check** | decisions[].entry_error / exit_error mention Kite; code review of live_ltp |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_jev_book.py::test_live_ltp_never_falls_back_to_delayed_prices; backend/tests/test_jev_book.py::test_the_live_price_gate_knows_the_0600_expiry` |
| **Source** | README §86, §113; docs/research/prereg-jev-book.md (Clarifications 3 and 9) |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>JEV-08</code> <b>Active</b> — If Kite has no live session when the round is due (not connected, rejected, or past the 06:00 IST expiry without a reconnect), the day is recorded as…</summary>

If Kite has no live session when the round is due (not connected, rejected, or past the 06:00 IST expiry without a reconnect), the day is recorded as 'no_live_prices', Jev is not asked, and the day does not count as a session. The check is repeated before each stock: if Kite stops part-way, the remaining stocks are not asked and the round is recorded as interrupted (JEV-06).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The pre-registration requires live-price fills (#151). The old check ignored the 06:00 expiry, so on a morning without a reconnect Jev was asked and every fill failed (#158). |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/jev_book.py:decide_round and kite_live; backend/data_provider.py:kite_session_live` |
| **How to check** | Jev Book page 'No live prices' pill and explanation |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_jev_book.py::test_no_live_prices_skips_the_day_without_asking_jev; backend/tests/test_jev_book.py::test_the_live_price_gate_knows_the_0600_expiry; backend/tests/test_jev_book.py::test_a_kite_session_that_dies_mid_round_stops_asking_jev` |
| **Source** | docs/research/prereg-jev-book.md (Clarifications 3 and 9); README §113 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>JEV-09</code> <b>Active</b> — A decision whose entry or exit Kite can't price is marked excluded and left out of every figure.</summary>

A decision whose entry or exit Kite can't price is marked excluded and left out of every figure. A session counts toward the 60 only if at least one decision was priced live at both ends.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Only true live-price round trips are evidence. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/jev_book.py:decide_round, close_round, summary` |
| **How to check** | decisions[].excluded; summary.sessions_closed |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_jev_book.py::test_a_fill_without_a_live_price_is_excluded` |
| **Source** | docs/research/prereg-jev-book.md (Clarification 3) |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>JEV-10</code> <b>Active</b> — Jev positions close once, at the first tick of the 15:08 square-off window, at live price, with no stop and no target.</summary>

Jev positions close once, at the first tick of the 15:08 square-off window, at live price, with no stop and no target. The close waits until the decision thread has finished.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The pre-registered exit, matching the engine's MIS square-off. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/jev_book.py:maybe_close; backend/trading_engine.py:_tick_impl` |
| **Setting** | `SQUARE_OFF_TIME = '15:08'` |
| **How to check** | Activity log 'Jev book: closed today's paper positions'; decisions[].exit_at |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_jev_book.py::test_engine_hooks_fill_only_at_live_kite_prices` |
| **Source** | README §86 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>JEV-11</code> <b>Active</b> — Scoring: net_bp = sign x move_bp - the engine's intraday round trip at Rs 1,00,000 (14.27 bp) for buy or short, and 0 for skip.</summary>

Scoring: net_bp = sign x move_bp - the engine's intraday round trip at Rs 1,00,000 (14.27 bp) for buy or short, and 0 for skip. The scanner's side as the test was registered, the old score's stronger side (score_side, SCN-06), is scored the same way on the same prices, and is the side Jev's snapshot shows. The engine no longer acts on it (README §115); the book keeps it so the pass rule does not change mid-test (prereg-jev-book.md clarification 9).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Jev must beat costs and the scanner, not just the market. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/jev_book.py:close_round and round_trip_bp; backend/jev_book.py:scanner_side` |
| **Setting** | `JEV_BOOK.notional = 100000.0; COSTS.slippage_pct = 0.03` |
| **How to check** | Jev Book page 'after about N bp of costs'; summary.round_trip_bp |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_jev_book.py::test_skip_costs_nothing, backend/tests/test_scanner_side_shadow_log.py::test_the_jev_book_keeps_the_old_scores_side_in_its_snapshot_and_baseline` |
| **Source** | docs/research/prereg-jev-book.md (Clarification 1) |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>JEV-12</code> <b>Active</b> — Kill rule: after at least 100 buy/short decisions, if the cumulative net t-stat is below -2, the book switches itself off and runs no more rounds.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Stops a clearly losing judge early, with the threshold fixed in advance. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/jev_book.py:_apply_kill_rule; maybe_decide` |
| **Setting** | `JEV_BOOK.kill_after = 100; JEV_BOOK.kill_t = -2.0` |
| **How to check** | Jev Book page 'Switched off' pill and status_reason |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_jev_book.py::test_kill_rule_switches_the_book_off` |
| **Source** | docs/research/prereg-jev-book.md (Kill rule) |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>JEV-13</code> <b>Pending</b> — Verdict rule: evaluated once at 300 buy/short decisions or 60 counted sessions.</summary>

Verdict rule: evaluated once at 300 buy/short decisions or 60 counted sessions. To pass, mean net must be > 0 with t >= 2.24, positive in both halves, and beat the scanner (paired mean > 0 with t >= 1.65). The code only flags verdict_due and exposes t, halves and paired_t; the pass or fail call is made by hand.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The family-level significance bar (N_family = 2), set before any decision. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/jev_book.py:summary` |
| **Setting** | `jev_book.DEFAULTS.verdict_after_decisions = 300; jev_book.DEFAULTS.verdict_after_sessions = 60` |
| **How to check** | Jev Book page 'The verdict is now due'; GET /api/jev-book t, halves, paired_t |
| **Source** | docs/research/prereg-jev-book.md (Pass rule) |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>JEV-14</code> <b>Paper only</b> — Even a pass gives Jev no authority: nothing in the engine's decision path reads the Jev book.</summary>

Even a pass gives Jev no authority: nothing in the engine's decision path reads the Jev book. Using it (for example as a review-queue filter) is a separate owner decision.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A forward test result is evidence, not a switch-on. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/trading_engine.py:_tick_impl (lines 1418-1421; only maybe_decide/maybe_close)` |
| **How to check** | grep jev_book backend/\*.py: only trading_engine hooks and app.py summary |
| **Source** | docs/research/prereg-jev-book.md (Kill rule paragraph) |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>JEV-15</code> <b>Active</b> — While a round is open, the Jev Book page shows where its positions stand at Kite's last traded prices.</summary>

While a round is open, the Jev Book page shows where its positions stand at Kite's last traded prices. The mark is for display only: it is never written to the state file and never enters a score, the kill rule or the verdict.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The owner needs to see that the book is trading before the 15:08 close, and the test's record must still be the close alone. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/jev_book.py:live_marks; backend/jev_book.py:page; backend/app.py:jev_book_summary` |
| **Setting** | `MARK_TTL_S = 30 (one Kite call serves page refreshes for 30 s)` |
| **How to check** | Jev Book page while a round is open: the pill reads 'Open until 15:08' and an 'If closed now' line shows the mark; GET /api/jev-book carries it under 'live'. backend/data/jev_book_state.json holds no mark fields. |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_jev_book.py::test_the_live_mark_is_never_stored_and_never_scored` |
| **Source** | README §90; docs/research/prereg-jev-book.md (Clarification 4) |

</details>

## Order-book sampler

Data collection for the one open intraday test.

<details>
<summary><code>OBK-01</code> <b>Active</b> — In the open phase (09:15-15:08) the engine takes one Kite quote call per tick for the whole watchlist and writes one depth_samples row per stock with…</summary>

In the open phase (09:15-15:08) the engine takes one Kite quote call per tick for the whole watchlist and writes one depth_samples row per stock with a two-sided book.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Builds the only new data source for a future intraday brain. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/depth_sampler.py:sample; backend/trading_engine.py:_tick_impl` |
| **Setting** | `DEPTH_SAMPLER.enabled = True` |
| **How to check** | GET /api/journal/depth-samples (rows, sessions, last_ts) |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_depth_sampler.py::test_sample_writes_one_row_per_symbol_and_survives_a_bad_quote` |
| **Source** | README §71 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>OBK-02</code> <b>Active</b> — The NIFTYBEES and SETFNIF50 books and the NIFTY 50 level are sampled only inside [09:15, 09:30) and [15:00, 15:30) IST, with one quote call per tick…</summary>

The NIFTYBEES and SETFNIF50 books and the NIFTY 50 level are sampled only inside [09:15, 09:30) and [15:00, 15:30) IST, with one quote call per tick in a window and none outside.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Records the spread an overnight ETF hold would actually pay, at no cost outside those windows. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/depth_sampler.py:sample_windows; backend/trading_engine.py:_tick_impl` |
| **Setting** | `DEPTH_SAMPLER.window_symbols = ['NIFTYBEES','SETFNIF50']; DEPTH_SAMPLER.window_indices = ['NIFTY 50']; DEPTH_SAMPLER.windows = [['09:15','09:30'],['15:00','15:30']]` |
| **How to check** | SELECT DISTINCT time(ts,'unixepoch','+330 minutes') FROM depth_samples WHERE symbol='NIFTYBEES' |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_depth_sampler.py::test_window_sampler_is_a_no_op_outside_its_windows` |
| **Source** | README §81 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>OBK-03</code> <b>Active</b> — The depth samplers write only when Kite data is active, never from the delayed feed, and never raise: a failed fetch or write is a logged gap, not a…</summary>

The depth samplers write only when Kite data is active, never from the delayed feed, and never raise: a failed fetch or write is a logged gap, not a stalled tick.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Data collection must never block trading. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/depth_sampler.py:sample and sample_windows` |
| **How to check** | backend log 'Depth sample skipped' warnings; engine keeps ticking |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_depth_sampler.py::test_a_failing_fetch_never_raises` |
| **Source** | README §71 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>OBK-04</code> <b>Pending</b> — depth_samples changes no decision: no live module reads it.</summary>

depth_samples changes no decision: no live module reads it. It feeds only the pre-registered order-book test, which runs after 15 full sessions counted from 2026-09-28 and needs a quintile spread above 33.26 bp with t > 2 that survives BH correction.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Keeps a data-collection feature from becoming an untested signal. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/depth_sampler.py (module docstring; no live module reads depth_samples)` |
| **How to check** | grep depth_samples backend/\*.py: only database.py writers/stats |
| **Source** | docs/research/prereg-orderbook.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>OBK-05</code> <b>Active</b> — Every depth_samples row with a book also stores the book itself: each non-empty level of each side, best first, as [price, quantity, orders] in…</summary>

Every depth_samples row with a book also stores the book itself: each non-empty level of each side, best first, as [price, quantity, orders] in bid_levels_json and ask_levels_json. The summary columns (bid, ask, spread_bp, bid_qty1, ask_qty1, bid_qty5, ask_qty5, imbalance5, volume, total_buy_qty, total_sell_qty) are computed from the same levels, exactly as before. The level columns were added by a migration that rewrote no row: rows recorded before the deploy, and index rows, hold NULL there.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | With only the touch and the five-level sums, the cost of an order past level 1 (#66) could only be modelled. The pre-registered order-book test reads the summary columns, so their meaning must not change. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/depth_sampler.py:snapshot, levels_json; backend/database.py:_migrate, record_depth_samples; backend/research/measure_real_slippage.py:measure` |
| **How to check** | GET /api/journal/depth-samples -> rows_with_levels grows from the first session after the deploy; SELECT ask_levels_json FROM depth_samples ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1 |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_depth_sampler.py::test_snapshot_records_all_five_levels_with_orders_from_a_kite_quote; backend/tests/test_depth_sampler.py::test_the_existing_columns_keep_their_meaning; backend/tests/test_depth_sampler.py::test_the_migration_adds_the_level_columns_to_an_old_journal_and_rewrites_nothing; backend/tests/test_measure_real_slippage.py::test_main_uses_recorded_levels_where_a_row_has_them_and_says_so` |
| **Source** | README §112, #188; docs/research/prereg-orderbook.md (Amendment 6) |

</details>

## Research desk and diagnostics

Grounded briefs and the holdings read. Never touch orders.

<details>
<summary><code>DSK-01</code> <b>Off by default</b> — The Research Desk is off by default.</summary>

The Research Desk is off by default. The dashboard toggle changes only in-memory config, so a restart turns it off again. Switching it on requires an available LLM backend.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | One brief is about 12 model calls of real money or plan usage. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/research_desk.py:set_enabled; backend/app.py:set_research_desk_enabled` |
| **Setting** | `RESEARCH_DESK.enabled = False; RESEARCH_DESK.llm_backend = 'auto'` |
| **How to check** | Stock page > Research desk tab button 'Switch the desk on'; GET /api/research/status enabled |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_research_desk.py::test_desk_is_off_by_default` |
| **Source** | README §44 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>DSK-02</code> <b>Active</b> — The Research Desk has no path to orders or gates.</summary>

The Research Desk has no path to orders or gates. Only app.py imports it, and nothing it writes feeds confidence, the checklist, sizing or any entry gate.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A research opinion must not become an unvalidated trading signal. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/research_desk.py (module docstring; only backend/app.py imports it)` |
| **How to check** | grep 'import research_desk' backend/\*.py returns only app.py |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_research_desk.py::test_desk_has_no_path_to_orders_or_gates` |
| **Source** | README §44 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>DSK-03</code> <b>Active</b> — Daily caps per IST day: 25 briefs and $10 of list-price cost.</summary>

Daily caps per IST day: 25 briefs and \$10 of list-price cost. A brief stops mid-way when the cost cap is reached, a run takes at most 25 symbols, and only one run happens at a time (409 otherwise). The counters are in memory and reset on restart.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Bounds real spend from a many-call feature. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/research_desk.py:_blocked_reason, _Brief.ask, request_run` |
| **Setting** | `RESEARCH_DESK.daily_brief_limit = 25; RESEARCH_DESK.daily_cost_limit_usd = 10.0; RESEARCH_DESK.max_symbols_per_run = 25` |
| **How to check** | Research desk tab chips 'Briefs today n of 25', 'List-price cost today \$x of \$10' |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_research_desk.py::test_cost_limit_stops_a_brief_midway` |
| **Source** | README §44 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>DSK-04</code> <b>Active</b> — Every agent output must validate against a strict schema.</summary>

Every agent output must validate against a strict schema. Each point must cite snapshot paths that exist and may only write numbers found in the snapshot. Ungrounded points are dropped and listed.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Stops invented facts and numbers from reaching the user. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/research_desk.py:Grounding.problem and _ground` |
| **How to check** | Research desk tab 'statement(s) dropped' list; reports_json.rejected |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_research_desk.py::test_invented_numbers_and_missing_fields_are_dropped` |
| **Source** | README §44 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>DSK-05</code> <b>Active</b> — The trader agent may only reuse the checklist's own entry, stop and target (within 0.005) or null, and a long or short proposal without the…</summary>

The trader agent may only reuse the checklist's own entry, stop and target (within 0.005) or null, and a long or short proposal without the checklist's stop becomes stand_aside.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Stops the model from inventing price levels. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/research_desk.py:_ground` |
| **How to check** | Research desk tab trader section; reports_json.rejected entries 'only the checklist's own entry...' |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_research_desk.py::test_trader_cannot_invent_levels` |
| **Source** | README §44 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>DSK-06</code> <b>Active</b> — The portfolio manager's rating is withheld (status 'ungrounded') if no grounded evidence remains to support it.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A rating with nothing behind it is not logged as evidence. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/research_desk.py:run_brief` |
| **How to check** | research_briefs.rating IS NULL for ungrounded briefs |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_research_desk.py::test_a_rating_without_grounded_evidence_is_withheld` |
| **Source** | README §44 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>DSK-07</code> <b>Pending</b> — The desk's rating earns no weight anywhere until its per-session Spearman IC is &gt; 0 with t &gt;= 2.0 over at least 20 sessions, each with 20+ rated…</summary>

The desk's rating earns no weight anywhere until its per-session Spearman IC is > 0 with t >= 2.0 over at least 20 sessions, each with 20+ rated stocks.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Every signal has to clear the same predictive-skill bar. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/database.py:research_rating_ic` |
| **Setting** | `evaluation.IC_MIN_T_STAT = 2.0` |
| **How to check** | Research desk tab 'Does the rating work?' note; GET /api/research/status rating_ic |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_research_desk.py::test_rating_ic_waits_for_enough_sessions` |
| **Source** | README §44 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>DSK-08</code> <b>Active</b> — On the Anthropic API backend, the desk refuses to run a model with no price on file.</summary>

On the Anthropic API backend, the desk refuses to run a model with no price on file. The CLI backend runs \`claude -p\` with tools, MCP, slash commands, settings and session persistence switched off, and a 240 s timeout.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The cost cap must be enforceable, and the CLI must be text-in, JSON-out only. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/research_desk.py:_blocked_reason and ClaudeCliBackend.command` |
| **Setting** | `RESEARCH_DESK.cli_timeout_s = 240` |
| **How to check** | GET /api/research/status blocked_reason |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_research_desk.py::test_cli_backend_runs_claude_with_everything_switched_off` |
| **Source** | README §44 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>DSK-09</code> <b>Active</b> — The holdings diagnostic is a read-only technical read of real Kite holdings, not a recommendation or forecast.</summary>

The holdings diagnostic is a read-only technical read of real Kite holdings, not a recommendation or forecast. It needs a Kite token (400 otherwise), and holdings with fewer than 60 daily bars are listed as unreadable rather than guessed.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Personalised investment advice is out of scope. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/portfolio_diagnostic.py:run; backend/app.py:portfolio_diagnostic_endpoint` |
| **How to check** | /portfolio/diagnostic page disclaimer and 'Couldn't fetch daily data for' line |
| **Source** | README §13 |

</details>

## Research protocol

How an idea is tested before it may run.

<details>
<summary><code>RES-01</code> <b>Active</b> — Write and commit the pre-registration before any code for that hypothesis exists.</summary>

Write and commit the pre-registration before any code for that hypothesis exists. It must fix the rule, universe, period, cost model, metric, sign convention and pass threshold.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A rule written after the data is seen can be shaped to fit it. |
| **Enforced in** | `docs/research/reviewer-inbox.md (header, standing rules); .claude/agents/research-reviewer.md ('Pre-registration came first')` |
| **How to check** | Read the first paragraph of the results file for the hashes, then git log on the PR branch: prereg commit precedes the script commit (3i: 1dc0501 then 890dfba). Note that squash merge hides this order on main. |
| **Source** | docs/research/report-2026-09-20.md §2; docs/research/reviewer-inbox.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-02</code> <b>Active</b> — One run per hypothesis.</summary>

One run per hypothesis. A re-run is allowed only for a crash before any statistic was printed, or for a declared bug fix with both runs recorded. Never for adjusted parameters.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Each extra run is an unrecorded attempt at finding an edge. |
| **Enforced in** | `.claude/agents/research-reviewer.md ('One run per hypothesis'); each prereg's 'Code and order' section` |
| **How to check** | Results file states 'one run' with a run timestamp; docs/research/data holds one output per stage, and any second output is named as such (momentum_3i_stage0_run1.json). |
| **Source** | docs/research/reviewer-inbox.md; docs/research/prereg-3i-momentum-corrected-data.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-03</code> <b>Active</b> — Selection runs use only sessions dated before HELD_OUT_START.</summary>

Selection runs use only sessions dated before HELD_OUT_START. The boundary is one named constant.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A single boundary keeps every run reporting against the same line. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/research/splits.py:HELD_OUT_START; splits.py:selection_holdout` |
| **Setting** | `HELD_OUT_START = "2026-01-02"` |
| **How to check** | grep HELD_OUT_START backend/research; each script asserts or filters on it (step3a_opening_range.py line 238). |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_research_splits.py::test_selection_and_heldout_split_at_the_named_boundary` |
| **Source** | docs/research/report-2026-09-20.md §8 amendment 6 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-04</code> <b>Active</b> — The bhavcopy loaders drop held-out sessions unless the caller passes include_held_out.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Once the cache held 2026 files, nothing stopped a selection run from reading them. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/research/slow_momentum.py:load_all (line 122, guard line 150); backend/research/nse_prices.py:load (line 202, guard line 223)` |
| **Setting** | `include_held_out = False (default)` |
| **How to check** | Call signature in both loaders; BUG_LOG.md row #135. |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_research_data_guards.py::test_loader_drops_held_out_sessions_unless_asked` |
| **Source** | README §78 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-05</code> <b>Active</b> — 2026 bhavcopies live in a separate folder that selection code never reads.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Physical separation backs up the loader guard. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/research/slow_momentum.py:HELD_OUT_DIR; backend/research/nse_prices.py:HELD_OUT_DIR` |
| **Setting** | `HELD_OUT_DIR = backend/data/bhav_daily_2026_heldout` |
| **How to check** | ls backend/data/bhav_daily_2026_heldout shows 182 zips, 20260101 to 20260925; bhav_daily ends at 20251231. |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_research_data_guards.py::test_loader_drops_held_out_sessions_unless_asked` |
| **Source** | README §78; docs/research/trials.md held-out exposure log |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-06</code> <b>Active</b> — The 2026 held-out window is spent only with the owner's say-so.</summary>

The 2026 held-out window is spent only with the owner's say-so. The reviewer cannot approve it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | It is the scarcest evidence in the project and cannot be recovered once read. |
| **Enforced in** | `.claude/agents/research-reviewer.md ('Hard limits'); docs/research/prereg-confluence-deep.md line 26` |
| **How to check** | The held-out exposure log in docs/research/trials.md shows one statistic, dated 2026-09-26, for the momentum family. The owner's approval for that look was given in conversation and is not recorded in the repository. |
| **Source** | docs/research/progress.md; docs/research/prereg-3e-wide-structure-short.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-07</code> <b>Active</b> — Log every read of data dated on or after HELD_OUT_START in the held-out exposure log, whether or not a statistic was computed.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The window is only as clean as the record of who has looked at it. |
| **Enforced in** | `docs/research/trials.md ('Held-out exposure log')` |
| **How to check** | Seven rows dated 2026-09-26; later pre-registrations name the sessions to exclude (prereg-overnight-etf.md). |
| **Source** | docs/research/trials.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-08</code> <b>Active</b> — A FAIL earns no held-out look.</summary>

A FAIL earns no held-out look. A result that passes the economic gates but fails the multiple-testing gate has failed.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Spending the window on a failed result changes no decision. |
| **Enforced in** | `docs/research/decision-2026-09-26-overnight-and-significance.md (safeguard 5)` |
| **How to check** | trials.md row 119: four gates passed, DSR failed, 'held-out NOT spent'. |
| **Source** | README §76, §80 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-09</code> <b>Active</b> — The family-level bar is prospective.</summary>

The family-level bar is prospective. No past trial is re-graded.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Re-grading after a result is seen is a forking path. |
| **Enforced in** | `docs/research/decision-2026-09-26-overnight-and-significance.md ('Rule, prospective only')` |
| **How to check** | trials.md row 119 still reads FAIL; results-3h shows the N = 1 figure 'for the reviewer only'. |
| **Source** | README §80 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-10</code> <b>Active</b> — Every backtest run of a strategy variant increments the trial count.</summary>

Every backtest run of a strategy variant increments the trial count. CLI runs log themselves; scripted runs are entered in the ledger by hand.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The count is the denominator of every significance claim. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/evaluation.py:log_trial; backend/backtester.py:main; backend/swing_backtester.py:main; backend/diagnose_entry_edge.py; backend/tune_entry_params.py` |
| **How to check** | trials.md strategy table is contiguous 1 to 125. |
| **Source** | docs/research/trials.md 'Rules' |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-11</code> <b>Active</b> — Measurements that select no strategy are research looks.</summary>

Measurements that select no strategy are research looks. They are logged individually and do not increment the trial count.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A look at the data is still a look and must be countable. |
| **Enforced in** | `docs/research/trials.md ('Research looks')` |
| **How to check** | Rows L1 to L39. L37 is missing from the table and is pending in prereg-orderbook.md. |
| **Source** | docs/research/report-2026-09-20.md §8 amendment 7 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-12</code> <b>Active</b> — A replication of an identical, already-counted configuration is logged and not counted.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Recovering a trade list is not a new attempt at an edge. |
| **Enforced in** | `docs/research/trials.md ('Replications')` |
| **How to check** | Rows R1 and R2. The search_diagnostics.py replication has no row. |
| **Source** | docs/research/reviewer-inbox.md Entry 1 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-13</code> <b>Active</b> — A void run still counts as a trial.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Its result was seen, so the denominator must grow. |
| **Enforced in** | `docs/research/trials.md (row 118)` |
| **How to check** | Row 118 reads 'VOID, not a verdict … counted as a trial'. |
