| **Source** | docs/research/prereg-3h-slow-momentum-delivery.md amendment 2 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-14</code> <b>Active</b> — An overstated trial count is never corrected downward.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Lowering it would weaken the bar in the project's own favour. |
| **Enforced in** | `docs/research/trials.md ('What a reviewer should notice')` |
| **How to check** | Rows 31-34 repeat 26-29 and remain counted. |
| **Source** | docs/research/report-phase-2-closing.md §4 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-15</code> <b>Active</b> — Amendments are appended to the pre-registration, dated, and state what had been seen.</summary>

Amendments are appended to the pre-registration, dated, and state what had been seen. Both runs' outputs are kept.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A reader must be able to tell a specification fix from a rescue. |
| **Enforced in** | `docs/research/prereg-*.md ('# Amendment N' and '# Clarification N' headings)` |
| **How to check** | prereg-3i amendment 1 heading; momentum_3i_stage0_run1.json beside momentum_3i_stage0.json. |
| **Source** | docs/research/prereg-3i-momentum-corrected-data.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-16</code> <b>Active</b> — Data gates are coded as halts and run before any forward return is read.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A gate coded as a report let a judgement be made after the ICs were seen. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/research/step3f_stage0_checks.py; backend/research/momentum_3i.py (stage0); backend/research/overnight_etf.py (stage0, lines 170-200)` |
| **Setting** | `overnight ETF: COVERAGE_GATE = 0.95, LIQ_GATE_RS = 5000000; 3i: adjustment consistency >= 97%` |
| **How to check** | 3f closed at stage 0 (93.41%) with no look or trial spent. |
| **Source** | docs/research/report-phase-2-closing.md §6; docs/research/results-3f-stage0.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-17</code> <b>Active</b> — Where possible, a cheap measurement gates the expensive backtest, and the trial is spent only if the measurement clears.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | It withdrew 3b without spending a trial. |
| **Enforced in** | `docs/research/prereg-3b-intraday-momentum.md; backend/research/step3b_stage1.py` |

| **How to check** | trials.md L31 and L32; no trial 36 for 3b. |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-18</code> <b>Active</b> — No live module may import from backend/research.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Research code changes fast and is not held to engine standards. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/tests/test_research_splits.py:test_no_live_module_imports_research; backend/research/__init__.py` |
| **How to check** | CI runs the test on every PR. |

| **Source** | docs/research/report-2026-09-20.md §8 amendment 8 |

<details>
<summary><code>RES-19</code> <b>Active</b> — Live code that needs research logic carries its own copy, and a parity test holds the two to the same answers.</summary>

| --- | --- |

<details>

| --- | --- |

<details>
<summary><code>RES-26</code> <b>Active</b> — A forward paper book carries a pre-registered band and switches itself off on a breach.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-27</code> <b>Active</b> — A pass authorises a paper book only.</summary>

A pass authorises a paper book only. Real money is a separate owner decision, and no result is described as a guarantee.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The project is real-money-adjacent and the evidence is statistical. |
| **Enforced in** | `docs/research/decision-2026-09-26-overnight-and-significance.md §1; .claude/agents/research-reviewer.md ('Hard limits')` |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-28</code> <b>Active</b> — Each completed step goes to the reviewer before the next begins.</summary>

Each completed step goes to the reviewer before the next begins. The reviewer writes only to reviewer-inbox.md, newest entry first, and the main session answers in reviewer-outbox.md.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | It is the substitute for a second person. |
| **Enforced in** | `docs/research/reviewer-inbox.md (header); .claude/agents/research-reviewer.md` |
| **How to check** | Inbox Entries 1-18 each have a 'Re: Entry N' in the outbox. Dormant since Entry 18 (2026-09-24); later runs state they had no reviewer review. |
| **Source** | docs/research/reviewer-inbox.md |

</details>

<details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-32</code> <b>Active</b> — The Kronos store (backend/data/kronos.db) is written only by research processes, through the JSON files it ingests (the shadow's day and summary…</summary>

The Kronos store (backend/data/kronos.db) is written only by research processes, through the JSON files it ingests (the shadow's day and summary files in backend/data, the L40 records in docs/research/data), and is read only by the two display routes /api/kronos and /api/kronos/day/{date}. No decision in the engine reads it: no entry, size, exit, scanner score or checklist read touches the store or its files.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Kronos is research look L40, not a strategy. A page and a database for its forecasts must not become a signal by accident; the boundary is that the engine never imports the store and the store never imports research code. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/kronos_store.py:page; backend/kronos_store.py:day_page; backend/app.py:kronos_page; backend/app.py:kronos_day` |
| **How to check** | GET /api/kronos shows the shadow's latest day and the L40 records; grep -l kronos_store backend/\*.py lists app.py and kronos_store.py only |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_kronos_store.py::test_nothing_in_the_engine_imports_the_store; backend/tests/test_kronos_store.py::test_app_declares_the_two_routes_and_they_only_read; backend/tests/test_research_splits.py::test_no_live_module_imports_research` |
| **Source** | README §102 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-33</code> <b>Active</b> — No new look for an intraday edge is started (the owner's decision of 2026-09-30).</summary>

No new look for an intraday edge is started (the owner's decision of 2026-09-30). The monthly momentum book is the strategy, and the intraday engine runs in paper as a record. L52, pre-registered before the decision, stays on hold and is scored only if the owner asks. Real money stays a separate owner decision (RES-27). The owner asked for the single-rule lab (L54) and its historical search (L55) on 2026-10-05; both are recorded as owner-requested.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | 202 trials and looks L40 to L51 found no intraday edge that pays the ~16.6 bp round trip; the one strategy that passed is positional. |
| **Enforced in** | `docs/research/decisions/decision-2026-09-30-momentum-core.md (an owner decision, not enforced in code)` |
| **How to check** | docs/research/trials.md: no research look on an intraday edge dated after 2026-09-30 unless the owner asked for it |
| **Source** | README §116; README §124 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-34</code> <b>Paper only</b> — The rule lab (L54) runs each registered single rule (20 of its own in cohort 1, 87 from the YouTube and practitioner catalogs in cohort 2…</summary>

The rule lab (L54) runs each registered single rule (20 of its own in cohort 1, 87 from the YouTube and practitioner catalogs in cohort 2, backend/rule_lab_catalog.py) as a shadow paper book on the day's list: a signal on a finished 5-minute bar enters at the next bar's open, Rs 50,000, config.COSTS on both legs, one open trade per rule per stock, exit 30 minutes later (or the 15:05 bar); R19/R20 exit on a stop beyond the signal bar, a 3R target or the 15:05 bar, stop first when a bar reaches both. The rules, the trade and the looks are fixed in docs/research/prereg-rule-lab.md; a rule is added only by a dated amendment. Short rules are traded whatever SCANNER.allow_shorts says (shadow trades are not orders); a long-only stock skips its shorts.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The owner's idea: one small rule per book, so a rule that works is not diluted by the others, judged only by a test fixed in advance. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/rule_lab.py:simulate_session` |
| **Setting** | `RULE_LAB` |
| **How to check** | GET /api/rule-lab lists 20 rules; rule_lab_trades rows carry entry and exit times 30 minutes apart |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_rule_lab.py::test_entry_next_open_exit_after_30_minutes_and_costs` |
| **Source** | README §124; docs/research/prereg-rule-lab.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-35</code> <b>Paper only</b> — The rule lab never places an order and writes only rule_lab_trades and rule_lab_sessions.</summary>

The rule lab never places an order and writes only rule_lab_trades and rule_lab_sessions. It runs after the tick's own work, on candles the tick already fetched, inside its own try/except and the engine's, within a 1.5 s budget a tick; a finished bar's signals are computed once and cached. Nothing that trades reads its statuses; nothing is promoted automatically.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A research book must not be able to change, slow or stop the engine, nor move a rule toward live money without the owner. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/rule_lab.py:RuleLab; backend/trading_engine.py:TradingEngine._run_rule_lab` |
| **Setting** | `RULE_LAB` |
| **How to check** | With the lab raising, a tick still completes and positions, capital and the daily-loss counter are unchanged |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_rule_lab.py::test_a_failing_lab_cannot_touch_the_tick_or_the_book` |
| **Source** | README §124 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-36</code> <b>Pending</b> — A rule-lab rule is judged only at its pre-registered looks: the forward screen after its cohort's 40th lab session (at least 200 trades and 20…</summary>

A rule-lab rule is judged only at its pre-registered looks: the forward screen after its cohort's 40th lab session (at least 200 trades and 20 sessions, mean > 0, both halves positive, Romano-Wolf stepdown with every registered rule in the maximum at the cohort's alpha, 5% x 2^-cohort), then a confirmation on the next 40 untouched sessions. A confirmed rule may only be proposed to the owner; the proposal spends one trial, and live needs the owner's yes, the existing live gate, and a quarter of normal risk first.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Testing 20 or more rules on one record finds some by luck; one error budget for every rule ever added keeps the lab honest. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/rule_lab.py:evaluate` |
| **How to check** | /api/rule-lab shows every rule 'collecting' until 40 lab sessions; statuses are recomputed deterministically from the journal |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_rule_lab.py::test_screen_look_at_40_sessions_and_confirmation_on_the_next_40` |
| **Source** | docs/research/prereg-rule-lab.md §6, §7, amendments 1-2, 4 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-37</code> <b>Pending</b> — L55, the rule lab's historical search, runs singles, pairs, triples and a bounded greedy search of same-side conditions with both exits on the Kite…</summary>

L55, the rule lab's historical search, runs singles, pairs, triples and a bounded greedy search of same-side conditions with both exits on the Kite cache 2024-09-20 to 2025-12-31 only, over at most 116,746 combinations of the 107 conditions (amendment 4), judged by Romano-Wolf over every combination evaluated, with PBO by CSCV and the deflated Sharpe of the best. At most 5 survivors get one pass on 2026, only after an independent review; 2026 is otherwise read only as a row count.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The owner asked for permutations and combinations backtested now; a search this wide needs a whole-family correction and an untouched confirmation. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/research/rule_lab_screen.py:discover` |
| **How to check** | docs/research/data/l55_stage0.json: newest_bar_read before 2026-01-01, no return computed |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_rule_lab.py::test_stage0_counts_without_returns` |
| **Source** | docs/research/prereg-rule-lab.md amendment 3 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>RES-38</code> <b>Active</b> — Every rule-lab condition is causal: a signal on a bar reads only that bar and earlier ones, and a 15- or 60-minute bar is read only once its last…</summary>

Every rule-lab condition is causal: a signal on a bar reads only that bar and earlier ones, and a 15- or 60-minute bar is read only once its last 5-minute bar has finished.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A condition that peeks at a later bar would make both the forward lab and the historical search look better than any real trade could. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/rule_lab_catalog.py:resampled; backend/rule_lab_catalog.py:completes_htf` |
| **How to check** | Delete the bars after a signal bar and recompute: the same rules fire |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_rule_lab.py::test_every_condition_is_causal` |
| **Source** | docs/research/prereg-rule-lab.md amendment 4 §2 |

</details>

## Evaluation and statistics

The gates a result must clear.

<details>
<summary><code>EVL-01</code> <b>Active</b> — A new hypothesis must show net-of-cost |t| above the two-sided Bonferroni bound at 5% across its family size.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Charging a new mechanism for 119 unrelated intraday trials made every new idea unpassable. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/research/momentum_3i.py:T_GATE_A; backend/research/overnight_etf.py:T_GATE; backend/research/ranker.py:T_GATE1` |
| **Setting** | `N=2: t >= 2.24; N=3: t >= 2.394; N=5: t >= 2.58` |
| **How to check** | pass_rule object in docs/research/data/momentum_3i_partA.json and overnight_etf_h1.json. |
| **Source** | docs/research/decision-2026-09-26-overnight-and-significance.md; README §80 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>EVL-02</code> <b>Active</b> — A family is one economic mechanism named before data is read.</summary>

A family is one economic mechanism named before data is read. N_family counts every pre-registered configuration, earlier trials of the mechanism and every look tested against a pass rule. Floor 2. A family cannot be renamed to reset N.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Without a floor and a naming rule the easier bar becomes a way to reset the count. |
| **Enforced in** | `docs/research/decision-2026-09-26-overnight-and-significance.md §2; N_FAMILY constants in momentum_3i.py, overnight_etf.py, ranker.py` |
| **Setting** | `N_family >= 2` |
| **How to check** | Each prereg has a 'Family and count' section; 3i counts the void trial 118 in N = 3. |
| **Source** | docs/research/decision-2026-09-26-overnight-and-significance.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>EVL-03</code> <b>Active</b> — The corrected Deflated Sharpe must be at least 0.95 at N_family.</summary>

The corrected Deflated Sharpe must be at least 0.95 at N_family. The project-wide figure is reported for information.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A t-stat alone ignores skew, kurtosis and the number of tries. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/evaluation.py:deflated_sharpe_ratio; backend/research/momentum_3i.py` |
| **Setting** | `DSR >= 0.95` |
| **How to check** | results-3i: family DSR 0.98, project-wide 0.62 stated as information. |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_deflated_sharpe.py::test_needs_about_t_4_3_at_119_trials` |
| **Source** | README §77, §80 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>EVL-04</code> <b>Active</b> — The DSR luck baseline uses the null-consistent Sharpe dispersion 1/sqrt(n-1) unless the caller supplies one.</summary>

The DSR luck baseline uses the null-consistent Sharpe dispersion 1/sqrt(n-1) unless the caller supplies one. It must not scale with the candidate's own Sharpe.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The old default made the gate fail for every strategy above about 21 trials. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/evaluation.py:deflated_sharpe_ratio` |
| **Setting** | `sharpe_std = 1 / sqrt(n - 1)` |
| **How to check** | BUG_LOG.md row #132 with deploy note. |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_deflated_sharpe.py::test_baseline_does_not_scale_with_the_candidates_sharpe` |
| **Source** | README §77 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>EVL-05</code> <b>Retired</b> — The old DSR default sharpe_std = |SR| / 2 is withdrawn.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A synthetic edge with t near 71 scored 0.0 under it. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/evaluation.py:deflated_sharpe_ratio (comment, lines 72-78)` |

<details>
<summary><code>EVL-06</code> <b>Retired</b> — The project-wide DSR at the full trial count is no longer the pass gate for pre-registrations dated 2026-09-26 or later.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |

A raw positive backtest is not a pass. Every gate in the pre-registered rule must hold, net of costs.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Ten tests at 5% produce a false positive by chance. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/research/step2_feature_ic.py; docs/research/prereg-step2-feature-ic.md` |

<details>
<summary><code>EVL-17</code> <b>Active</b> — The Scorecard's expectancy, win rate and Deflated Sharpe count one trade per position: a position's closing legs are summed by position_id, and its R…</summary>

The Scorecard's expectancy, win rate and Deflated Sharpe count one trade per position: a position's closing legs are summed by position_id, and its R is the total net over initial risk x entry quantity. A row without a position_id counts on its own.

| | |

| **Enforced in** | `backend/database.py:closed_trade_rs, trade_stats, journal_summary` |

| **Source** | README §122, issue #257 |

</details>

## Security

Keys, authentication and what never gets committed.

<details>
<summary><code>SEC-01</code> <b>Active</b> — Every HTTP route except /kite/callback (and CORS preflight OPTIONS) requires the dashboard key in the X-Api-Key header; a missing or wrong header…</summary>

Every HTTP route except /kite/callback (and CORS preflight OPTIONS) requires the dashboard key in the X-Api-Key header; a missing or wrong header gets 401. A ?key= query parameter is ignored, so a request that only carries ?key= is refused with 401.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | uvicorn logs every request line, so a key in a URL ended up in backend.log in plain text (#87). |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/app.py:ApiKeyMiddleware.dispatch` |
| **How to check** | curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/state -> 401 with 'send it in the X-Api-Key header'; same with ?key=&lt;k> -> 401; with header -> 200. The test covers the key comparison only; no test calls a route without the header. |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_auth.py::test_key_ok_accepts_only_the_exact_key` |
| **Source** | README §60; CLAUDE.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>SEC-02</code> <b>Active</b> — /kite/login and /api/kite/login-url require the key.</summary>

/kite/login and /api/kite/login-url require the key. Only /kite/callback is public, because Zerodha's redirect cannot carry the header, and it only exchanges a one-time token against our own api_secret.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Nobody but the owner should be able to start a new Kite session. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/app.py:PUBLIC_PATHS` |
| **How to check** | curl /kite/login without header -> 401; /kite/callback without header -> 400 HTML 'Kite login didn't complete' |
| **Source** | README §60, §62 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>SEC-03</code> <b>Active</b> — The key comparison is constant-time (hmac.compare_digest) and refuses everything when no key is configured or none is supplied.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A wrong key's timing must not reveal how close it was. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/auth.py:key_ok` |
| **How to check** | Code read; unit test |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_auth.py::test_key_ok_refuses_everything_when_no_key_is_configured` |
| **Source** | README §60 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>SEC-04</code> <b>Active</b> — The WebSocket /ws is accepted without a key, and its first frame must be {"type":"auth","key":...} within 5 s.</summary>

The WebSocket /ws is accepted without a key, and its first frame must be {"type":"auth","key":...} within 5 s. Otherwise it is closed with code 4401. After auth the server only pushes state snapshots every 3 s.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Browsers cannot set headers on the WebSocket handshake, and the key must not ride in the URL. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/auth.py:authenticate_websocket; backend/app.py:websocket_endpoint` |
| **Setting** | `auth.AUTH_TIMEOUT_S = 5.0` |
| **How to check** | Browser devtools WS frames: auth frame then snapshots; wrong key -> close 4401 |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_auth.py::test_websocket_wrong_key_or_wrong_shape_is_closed_4401` |
| **Source** | README §60; CLAUDE.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>SEC-05</code> <b>Active</b> — A log filter on the uvicorn, uvicorn.access and uvicorn.error loggers and their handlers rewrites any key=...</summary>

A log filter on the uvicorn, uvicorn.access and uvicorn.error loggers and their handlers rewrites any key=... or request_token=... in a formatted log line to &lt;redacted>.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Defence in depth against stale bookmarks, and against Kite's one-time token in the callback URL. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/auth.py:RedactKeyFilter / install_log_redaction; installed at backend/app.py line 106` |
| **How to check** | grep -c 'key=' ~/Library/Logs/TraderSahab/backend.log shows only '&lt;redacted>' |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_auth.py::test_filter_redacts_uvicorn_style_records_whose_path_is_an_argument` |
| **Source** | README §60, §62 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>SEC-06</code> <b>Active</b> — The dashboard key is the DASHBOARD_API_KEY env var, otherwise backend/.dashboard_key.json, otherwise newly generated with secrets.token_urlsafe(32)…</summary>

The dashboard key is the DASHBOARD_API_KEY env var, otherwise backend/.dashboard_key.json, otherwise newly generated with secrets.token_urlsafe(32) and saved with mode 0600. It is printed in full only on the run that generated it; later startups print first6...last4.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Avoid writing a trading-control credential to stdout on every restart. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/config.py:_load_or_create_dashboard_key; backend/config.py:write_secret_file; backend/app.py` |
| **Setting** | `DASHBOARD_API_KEY_IS_NEW = False unless generated this run` |
| **How to check** | Startup log line 'Dashboard API key: xxxxxx...xxxx (unchanged ...)'; stat -f %Sp backend/.dashboard_key.json -> -rw------- |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_secret_files.py::test_the_dashboard_key_file_is_created_0600` |
| **Source** | README Setup; issue #87; README §114 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>SEC-07</code> <b>Active</b> — The Kite session (api_key, api_secret, access_token, generated_at) is written to backend/.kite_session.json with mode 0600 from the first byte…</summary>

The Kite session (api_key, api_secret, access_token, generated_at) is written to backend/.kite_session.json with mode 0600 from the first byte, through a 0600 temporary file that replaces it, and the in-process config globals are updated so no restart is needed.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | It is a live broker credential. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/config.py:save_kite_session; backend/config.py:write_secret_file` |
| **How to check** | stat -f %Sp backend/.kite_session.json -> -rw------- |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_secret_files.py::test_the_kite_session_file_is_written_0600` |
| **Source** | CLAUDE.md Rules |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>SEC-08</code> <b>Active</b> — Secret and runtime files are gitignored and never committed: the Kite session, the dashboard key, the TypeSafe key, the Telegram config, every…</summary>

Secret and runtime files are gitignored and never committed: the Kite session, the dashboard key, the TypeSafe key, the Telegram config, every database under backend/data, raw data caches and both books' state files.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Never commit credentials or the journal. |
| **Enforced in** | `.gitignore` |
| **How to check** | git check-ignore -v backend/.kite_session.json backend/.dashboard_key.json backend/.typesafe_key.json backend/data/sahab_journal.db backend/data/momentum_book_state.json |
| **Source** | CLAUDE.md Rules |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>SEC-09</code> <b>Active</b> — CORS only allows the local dashboard origins, unless the CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS env var is set.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A wildcard origin plus a trading-control API was flagged by review. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/config.py:CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS; backend/app.py add_middleware` |
| **Setting** | `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = ['http://localhost:5500', 'http://127.0.0.1:5500']` |
| **How to check** | Preflight from another origin gets no Access-Control-Allow-Origin |
| **Source** | README §19 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>SEC-10</code> <b>Active</b> — The Telegram bot token is never logged.</summary>

The Telegram bot token is never logged. A network failure logs only the exception class, and an HTTP failure logs only the status code and Telegram's description.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The token is part of the Telegram API URL. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/telegram_alerts.py:_post` |
| **How to check** | GET /api/alerts/telegram last_error; backend log 'Telegram alert not sent: ...' |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_telegram_alerts.py::test_a_failure_never_logs_the_bot_token` |
| **Source** | README §66 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>SEC-11</code> <b>Active</b> — The TypeSafe key is read from the TYPESAFE_API_KEY env var or backend/.typesafe_key.json (written 0600 by typesafe_key.py set) and is never printed.</summary>

The TypeSafe key is read from the TYPESAFE_API_KEY env var or backend/.typesafe_key.json (written 0600 by typesafe_key.py set) and is never printed. \`status\` reports only whether one is stored.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Keep the key out of shell history, arguments and logs. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/jev_book.py:api_key; backend/typesafe_key.py:set_key` |
| **How to check** | backend/.venv/bin/python backend/typesafe_key.py status -> {stored, source} |
| **Source** | README §86 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>SEC-12</code> <b>Active</b> — Never commit anything in the root research/ folder except notes.</summary>

Never commit anything in the root research/ folder except notes. Book PDFs and archives stay local.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The books are copyrighted and some copies are not from legitimate sources. |
| **Enforced in** | `.gitignore (research/*.pdf, research/*.zip, research/Hands-On-Machine-Learning-for-Algorithmic-Trading-master/)` |
| **How to check** | git ls-files research lists five notes and no PDF. |
| **Source** | CLAUDE.md 'Rules' |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>SEC-13</code> <b>Active</b> — Never print or log a key or a Kite token.</summary>

Never print or log a key or a Kite token. The dashboard key travels in the X-Api-Key header or the first WebSocket message, never in a URL.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | URLs are logged. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/auth.py; CLAUDE.md ('Run')` |
| **Setting** | `?key= is refused with 401 since #87` |
| **How to check** | Request a route with ?key= and confirm 401; inspect the uvicorn log for redaction. |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_auth.py::test_redact_removes_the_key_from_query_strings` |
| **Source** | README §60 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>SEC-14</code> <b>Active</b> — Research reads the live journal read-only and adds nothing to the live order path.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A research query must not write, migrate or vacuum the running journal. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/research/journal_summary.py (line 16, SQLite URI with mode=ro)` |
| **Setting** | `DB = file:…/data/sahab_journal.db?mode=ro` |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>SEC-15</code> <b>Active</b> — At start-up every credential file in backend/ (the dashboard key, the Kite session, the TypeSafe key, the Telegram config) that other accounts can…</summary>

At start-up every credential file in backend/ (the dashboard key, the Kite session, the TypeSafe key, the Telegram config) that other accounts can read is set to 0600, and the start-up log names the files and their old modes, never their contents.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A file written before the 0600 rule, or by hand, would otherwise stay readable by every local account (#161). |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/config.py:tighten_secret_files; backend/config.py:SECRET_FILES; backend/app.py` |
| **How to check** | Startup log line 'Credential files other accounts could read were set to owner-only (0600): ...' when one was changed; stat -f %Sp backend/.\*.json -> -rw------- |

| **Source** | README §114 |

</details>

## Operations

Phases, restarts, locks, watchdogs and alerts.

<details>
<summary><code>OPS-01</code> <b>Active</b> — Pause entries: while paused, no new cash or F&amp;O entries and no review cards; stops, targets and the square-off keep running.</summary>

Pause entries: while paused, no new cash or F&O entries and no review cards; stops, targets and the square-off keep running. The pause is persisted and survives a restart.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | An autonomous agent needs an owner who can stop it without orphaning positions. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/trading_engine.py:set_entries_paused, _entry_block_reason, _try_enter_fno` |
| **Setting** | `control table key entries_paused` |
| **How to check** | POST /api/control/pause; header 'Entries paused' chip; /api/state entries_paused |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_kill_switch.py::test_the_pause_survives_a_restart` |
| **Source** | README §65 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>OPS-02</code> <b>Active</b> — Only one engine may write a journal: the pid lock file &lt;db&gt;.enginelock is taken at startup; a second live process raises EngineAlreadyRunning; a dead…</summary>

Only one engine may write a journal: the pid lock file &lt;db>.enginelock is taken at startup; a second live process raises EngineAlreadyRunning; a dead pid's lock is stale and taken over.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A test backend wrote 119 rows into the live journal on 2026-09-22. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/engine_lock.py:acquire; backend/app.py:lifespan` |
| **Setting** | `SAHAB_DB_PATH env (default backend/data/sahab_journal.db)` |
| **How to check** | backend/data/sahab_journal.db.enginelock contents; second instance exits at startup |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_engine_lock.py::test_acquire_then_second_process_is_refused` |
| **Source** | README §54, issue #70 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>OPS-03</code> <b>Active</b> — On restart, from today's journal: rebuild today's trades, realized P&amp;L and the daily-loss counter per mode (paper, live), per-stock entry counts…</summary>

On restart, from today's journal: rebuild today's trades, realized P&L and the daily-loss counter per mode (paper, live), per-stock entry counts, open cash positions (a position with a partial exit at its open quantity, net of its legs) (stop and target parsed from the entry note, entry charges carried) and open option positions (FNO-12): paper legs when in Paper, live legs always. Seed max_open_positions from the restored count.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A restart orphaned two open positions (GRASIM, HYUNDAI) and could erase today's losses from the loss limit. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/state.py:_rehydrate_today, _rehydrate_open_positions, _rehydrate_fno_positions; backend/trading_engine.py:TradingEngine.__init__` |
| **How to check** | activity 'Restored N open position(s) from today's journal after a restart' |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_restore_open_positions.py::test_an_open_short_is_restored_with_its_stop_target_and_entry_charges; backend/tests/test_engine_money_paths.py::test_a_part_closed_live_position_is_restored_at_its_open_quantity` |
| **Source** | README §67, issue #118, §121, issues #252, #254 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>OPS-04</code> <b>Active</b> — One failing cycle or symbol never stops the engine: tick() catches everything; per-symbol errors are isolated and logged once per distinct message; a…</summary>

One failing cycle or symbol never stops the engine: tick() catches everything; per-symbol errors are isolated and logged once per distinct message; a failed batch candle fetch falls back to per-symbol fetches.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | An uncaught exception used to kill the engine thread silently. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/trading_engine.py:tick, _tick_impl` |
| **How to check** | activity 'Internal error this cycle (recovered)'; /api/state last_error |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_fault_injection.py::test_tick_isolates_one_bad_symbol_from_the_rest` |
| **Source** | README §28, §43 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>OPS-05</code> <b>Active</b> — Tick watchdog: checked every 15 s; a tick running over 120 s dumps every thread's stack to the log once and raises an error activity.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A stalled tick means stops and entries aren't checked. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/trading_engine.py:_check_tick_stall, _watch_ticks` |
| **Setting** | `TICK_STALL_SECONDS = 120, TICK_WATCHDOG_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 15 (module constants)` |
| **How to check** | error activity 'The engine has been stuck on one cycle for N min' |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_kite_fallback_stall.py::test_watchdog_logs_stacks_once_for_a_stuck_tick` |
| **Source** | README §43 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>OPS-06</code> <b>Active</b> — Kite-session-expired alert: the first is immediate; repeats wait 15 min, then double up to a 4 h cap; a reconnect resets it to loud.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The alert was 95% of the error channel (40 identical rows overnight). |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/trading_engine.py:_sync_capital, reset_kite_executor` |
| **Setting** | `TOKEN_ALERT_MIN_INTERVAL = 900, TOKEN_ALERT_MAX_INTERVAL = 14400 (module constants)` |
| **How to check** | error activity 'Kite session has expired — click Reconnect' |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_kite_alert_backoff.py::test_interval_doubles_and_then_caps` |
| **Source** | README §55, issue #71 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>OPS-07</code> <b>Active</b> — Once per trading day, from 08:45 until the close, if Kite is configured but not live (one probe), raise one error alert.</summary>

Once per trading day, from 08:45 until the close, if Kite is configured but not live (one probe), raise one error alert. A restart doesn't repeat it.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Zerodha ends every session at 06:00 IST; a missing login should be loud before the open. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/trading_engine.py:_check_preopen_kite` |
| **Setting** | `PREOPEN_KITE_CHECK_TIME = "08:45"` |
| **How to check** | activity kind 'kite_preopen' (level error) |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_preopen_kite.py::test_no_live_session_at_0845_raises_one_error_alert` |
| **Source** | README §53 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>OPS-08</code> <b>Active</b> — Trading phases: closed on weekends, NSE holidays and outside [09:15, 15:30); 'open' [09:15, 15:08); 'square_off_window' [15:08, 15:30).</summary>

Trading phases: closed on weekends, NSE holidays and outside [09:15, 15:30); 'open' [09:15, 15:08); 'square_off_window' [15:08, 15:30). Symbol processing and entries run only in 'open'.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Trade only NSE cash hours; leave room for the square-off. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/trading_engine.py:market_phase, _tick_impl` |
| **Setting** | `MARKET_OPEN = "09:15", MARKET_CLOSE = "15:30", SQUARE_OFF_TIME = "15:08"` |
| **How to check** | /api/state market_status, holiday, next_open |
| **Source** | README §17 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>OPS-09</code> <b>Active</b> — The engine loop runs one tick, then sleeps 30 s.</summary>

The engine loop runs one tick, then sleeps 30 s. The scanner reruns every 5 min in market hours and every 60 min when closed on a trading day, and once on a weekend or holiday; the premarket scan runs once per date.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Cadence of decisions and plan refresh. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/trading_engine.py:run_forever, _tick_impl` |
| **Setting** | `POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 30; SCANNER.interval_minutes_open = 5, interval_minutes_closed = 60` |
| **How to check** | /api/state last_update_ts; activity kind 'scan' |
| **Source** | README §2, §14, §122 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>OPS-10</code> <b>Active</b> — The premarket shortlist seeds the watchlist only before the day's first live scan and only once per day.</summary>

The premarket shortlist seeds the watchlist only before the day's first live scan and only once per day. It never places an entry by itself.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Reaction time from the open without bypassing live confirmation. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/trading_engine.py:_maybe_seed_watchlist_from_premarket` |
| **Setting** | `SCANNER.enabled = True` |
| **How to check** | activity 'Pre-market shortlist seeded: …' |
| **Source** | README §14 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>OPS-11</code> <b>Active</b> — After the close (&gt;= 15:30) on a trading day, log one end-of-session summary line naming the gate that came closest.</summary>

After the close (>= 15:30) on a trading day, log one end-of-session summary line naming the gate that came closest. It is guarded in memory and against the activity table.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | 'Why did nothing fire today?' answers itself. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/trading_engine.py:_tick_impl` |
| **Setting** | `MARKET_CLOSE = "15:30"` |
| **How to check** | activity kind 'summary'; GET /api/journal/session-summary |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>OPS-12</code> <b>Active</b> — Every checklist read, signal, blocked entry and fill is journaled (checklist_evals, signals, activity, trades), whether or not it traded.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The journal is the evidence base for every research verdict. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/trading_engine.py:_process_symbol, _blocked; backend/state.py:log, record_trade` |
| **How to check** | GET /api/activity, /api/journal/blocker-stats, /api/journal/trades |

<details>
<summary><code>OPS-13</code> <b>Active</b> · known gap #162 — On weekends and on the dates in holidays.NSE_HOLIDAYS (held per year; 2026 only so far), the market phase is 'closed', so there are no entries, exits…</summary>

On weekends and on the dates in holidays.NSE_HOLIDAYS (held per year; 2026 only so far), the market phase is 'closed', so there are no entries, exits or square-off. One 'Markets are closed today for X. Trading resumes ...' line is logged per day, and next_open skips holidays. In a year with no list every weekday counts as a session and weekends stay closed; the engine then logs an error at start-up and on every pre-market read, and /api/state carries holiday_calendar_missing {year, message}.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | An NSE holiday is not an ordinary closed day, and a missing year would turn every holiday into a session without a word (#162). |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/trading_engine.py:market_phase, _tick_impl, _warn_if_no_holiday_calendar; backend/holidays.py:is_holiday / next_trading_day / calendar_missing` |
| **How to check** | /api/state holiday {name, next_trading_day} and holiday_calendar_missing; activity kind 'system' on a holiday; an error-level 'There is no NSE holiday list for &lt;year>' line in a year without one |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_holiday_calendar.py::test_a_year_without_a_list_logs_one_error_and_sets_the_state; backend/tests/test_holiday_calendar.py::test_the_pre_market_read_warns; backend/tests/test_holiday_calendar.py::test_start_up_warns` |
| **Source** | README 'Read this first' (NSE holidays hardcoded for 2026), §2, §114 |
| **Known gap** | [#162](https://github.com/harshece16/intraday-trading-agent/issues/162) |

</details>

<details>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Never leave the backend on the internet, or the journal locked, after exit. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/app.py:lifespan finally` |
| **How to check** | After stopping uvicorn: no ngrok process started by it; .enginelock removed |
| **Source** | README §62 |

</details>

Schema changes are additive and idempotent. CREATE IF NOT EXISTS runs on every connection, and _migrate adds trades.realized_gross (restating realized net of charges), checklist_evals.bar_time and manual_reviews.shadow_json only if they are missing.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Existing journals must upgrade in place without losing history. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/database.py:_migrate, _conn` |
| **How to check** | sqlite3 backend/data/sahab_journal.db 'PRAGMA table_info(trades)' shows realized_gross |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_net_pnl_charges.py::test_the_restatement_runs_once_and_is_safe_to_reopen` |
| **Source** | README §45 |

</details>

<summary><code>OPS-16</code> <b>Active</b> — Book state files are written atomically: the JSON goes to a .tmp file and is then moved into place with os.replace.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A crash mid-write must not corrupt the book. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/momentum_book.py:save_state; backend/jev_book.py:save_state` |
| **How to check** | No partial JSON in backend/data/\*_state.json |

</details>

## Engineering workflow

Branches, pull requests, CI and the bug log.

<details>
<summary><code>WFL-01</code> <b>Active</b> — Never commit straight to main.</summary>

Never commit straight to main. Branch as type/short-description off main.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Real-money-adjacent code gets a reviewable change history. |
| **Enforced in** | `WORKFLOW.md ('Branching model'); CLAUDE.md ('Workflow'). Not platform-enforced: branch protection needs GitHub Pro on a private repo.` |
| **How to check** | git log main: every commit since 2026-09-15 ends with a PR number. 33 earlier commits predate the workflow. |
| **Source** | WORKFLOW.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>WFL-02</code> <b>Active</b> — Commit messages use a Conventional Commit prefix and keep a prose body that explains why.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A scannable type without losing the reasoning. |
| **Enforced in** | `WORKFLOW.md ('Commits')` |
| **Setting** | `prefixes in use: feat, fix, docs, research, test, refactor, chore` |
| **How to check** | git log --format=%s main: docs 30, fix 29, research 22, feat 22. |
| **Source** | WORKFLOW.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>WFL-03</code> <b>Active</b> — Every change goes through a PR that fills the template: what and why with 'Closes #N', evidence from a real check, a self-review checklist and a…</summary>

Every change goes through a PR that fills the template: what and why with 'Closes #N', evidence from a real check, a self-review checklist and a one-line rollback plan.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The template is the substitute for a second reviewer. |
| **Enforced in** | `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` |
| **How to check** | Open any merged PR; 'Closes #N' drives the project board automation. |
| **Source** | WORKFLOW.md ('Pull requests') |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>WFL-04</code> <b>Active</b> — CI must be green before merge.</summary>

CI must be green before merge. CI runs the full backend pytest suite on Python 3.11 for every PR to main and every push to main.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Passing tests are table stakes; merging on red is not allowed. |
| **Enforced in** | `.github/workflows/tests.yml (job pytest)` |
| **Setting** | `python-version = 3.11; command = python -m pytest tests/ -v; working-directory = backend` |
| **How to check** | The 'Tests' check on the PR. Frontend lint and build are not in CI. |
| **Source** | WORKFLOW.md ('Review, without a second person') |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>WFL-05</code> <b>Active</b> — Merge by squash, one commit on main per logical change.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | It keeps main readable and matching the PR title. |
| **Enforced in** | `WORKFLOW.md ('Pull requests')` |
| **How to check** | Subjects on main end with '(#N)'. Side effect: prereg-before-code order is visible only on the PR branch. |
| **Source** | WORKFLOW.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>WFL-06</code> <b>Active</b> — A user-visible change adds a new numbered section to README.md.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The README is the project's running history. |
| **Enforced in** | `CLAUDE.md ('Workflow'); .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md (self-review checklist)` |
| **How to check** | grep '^### [0-9]\*\\.' README.md returns 88 sections, the last §88 dated 2026-09-27. |
| **Source** | CLAUDE.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>WFL-07</code> <b>Active</b> — Every confirmed bug gets a GitHub issue (label bug, or documentation) with evidence, and a row in BUG_LOG.md, whether or not it is fixed now.</summary>

Every confirmed bug gets a GitHub issue (label bug, or documentation) with evidence, and a row in BUG_LOG.md, whether or not it is fixed now. On merge the row moves to Fixed with the PR and the restart time.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A fix counts as live only once the backend has restarted on it. |
| **Enforced in** | `BUG_LOG.md (header); WORKFLOW.md ('Bugs')` |
| **How to check** | BUG_LOG.md: 2 open rows (#66, #43), 48 fixed; row #132 records the restart and PID. |
| **Source** | WORKFLOW.md; CLAUDE.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>WFL-08</code> <b>Active</b> — A bug fix adds or updates a regression test for the specific behaviour.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The same bug must not return unnoticed. |
| **Enforced in** | `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md ('Evidence' checklist)` |
| **How to check** | test_deflated_sharpe.py cites #132; test_research_data_guards.py cites #135 and #136. |
| **Test** | `backend/tests/test_deflated_sharpe.py::test_no_edge_series_does_not_pass` |
| **Source** | .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>WFL-09</code> <b>Active</b> — Backend code stays compatible with Python 3.9: no 'X | Y' type hints and no match statements.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Local Python is 3.9.6 while CI runs 3.11. |
| **Enforced in** | `CLAUDE.md ('Run'). Not CI-enforced: there is no 3.9 job.` |
| **Setting** | `local = Python 3.9.6; CI = 3.11` |
| **How to check** | Run the suite with backend/.venv/bin/python; grep for '\| None' annotations and 'match' in backend/ returns nothing. |
| **Source** | CLAUDE.md |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>WFL-10</code> <b>Active</b> — Claims are verified against real data, logs or the running app before they are reported.</summary>

Claims are verified against real data, logs or the running app before they are reported. Threshold changes are called out as tradeoffs.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Code that looks right is not evidence that it works. |
| **Enforced in** | `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md ('Evidence')` |
| **How to check** | BUG_LOG.md Fixed rows carry a deploy-and-verify note. |
| **Source** | WORKFLOW.md; CLAUDE.md 'Rules' |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>WFL-11</code> <b>Active</b> — Tests never touch the live journal or send alerts.</summary>

Tests never touch the live journal or send alerts. Every test runs against a temporary database with the Telegram credentials blanked.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The suite once wrote fake rows into the production activity table. |
| **Enforced in** | `backend/tests/conftest.py:isolated_db (autouse fixture, line 27)` |
| **Setting** | `database.DB_PATH = tmp_path / test_journal.db` |
| **How to check** | Run the suite and confirm backend/data/sahab_journal.db gains no TESTCO rows. |
| **Source** | README §26, §54 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>WFL-12</code> <b>Active</b> — Shared reviewer channel files are committed on their own and never left on an unmerged branch.</summary>

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Reviewer Entry 5 was lost that way. |
| **Enforced in** | `docs/research/report-phase-2-closing.md §6 (the incident that set the rule)` |
| **How to check** | git log -- docs/research/reviewer-inbox.md shows the inbox on main. |
| **Source** | docs/research/report-phase-2-closing.md §6 |

</details>

## Dashboard

What the pages may and may not do.

<details>
<summary><code>UI-01</code> <b>Active</b> — The dashboard keeps the key in localStorage['dashboardApiKey'].</summary>

The dashboard keeps the key in localStorage['dashboardApiKey']. A ?key= on the dashboard URL seeds it and is then stripped from the address bar. A 401 clears the stored key and reloads to prompt again. The ?api= override is accepted only for localhost or 127.0.0.1.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Keeps the key out of history and screenshots, and stops the dashboard being pointed at a foreign backend. |
| **Enforced in** | `frontend/src/api.js:getApiKey, apiFetch, API_BASE` |
| **How to check** | Load /?key=...; the address bar loses it; a wrong key triggers the 're-ask' alert |
| **Source** | README §60 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>UI-02</code> <b>Active</b> — The Momentum Book and Jev Book pages are read-only: they only GET their summaries every 60 s while the tab is visible, and no button on them changes…</summary>

The Momentum Book and Jev Book pages are read-only: they only GET their summaries every 60 s while the tab is visible, and no button on them changes book state.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The books follow only their pre-registered rules, with no manual override from the UI. |
| **Enforced in** | `frontend/src/pages/MomentumBook.jsx:MomentumBook; frontend/src/pages/JevBook.jsx:JevBook` |
| **How to check** | / (the Momentum Book) and /jev-book have no action buttons; network tab shows GETs every 60 s |
| **Source** | README §83, §86, §116 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>UI-03</code> <b>Active</b> — App state streams over the WebSocket every 3 s, with a reconnect 2 s after a close.</summary>

App state streams over the WebSocket every 3 s, with a reconnect 2 s after a close. /api/state is polled only after 8 s without a WebSocket message; an error response or a snapshot older (server_ts) than the one shown is dropped. The header's Kite status polls every 15 s while the tab is visible (every page poll stops in a hidden tab; the WebSocket keeps running) and spends a real probe on load and on window focus, at most once a minute.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | Keeps the UI live without spending a Kite call on every poll. |
| **Enforced in** | `frontend/src/api.js:useAppState, everyWhileVisible; backend/app.py:websocket_endpoint; frontend/src/components/Header.jsx` |
| **How to check** | Browser network tab: /ws frames about every 3 s and no /api/state while they arrive; stop the socket and /api/state appears about every 8 s; focusing the window twice within a minute sends one ?probe=true |
| **Source** | README §53, §119, §120 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>UI-04</code> <b>Active</b> — The Momentum Book is the dashboard's front page (/).</summary>

The Momentum Book is the dashboard's front page (/). The navigation leads with it, then groups the intraday engine's pages as the intraday paper record, the intraday research (Jev book, Kronos, Rule lab), and the account. The intraday Overview is at /intraday; /momentum-book and /overview still open their pages, query string kept. Every intraday page opens with a banner: a paper record, no intraday edge found (with its sources), the strategy is the momentum book, and the paper engine takes its trades automatically, the confidence gate applying in Live only (§118). The banner is text only and changes nothing the engine does.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | The owner's decision of 2026-09-30: the momentum book is the core of Trader Sahab, and the intraday engine is kept in paper as a record, not as the strategy. |
| **Enforced in** | `frontend/src/App.jsx:AppRoutes; frontend/src/components/Header.jsx:NAV; frontend/src/components/IntradayRecordBanner.jsx:IntradayRecordBanner` |
| **How to check** | Open the dashboard: / shows the Momentum Book; /intraday, /screener and the other intraday pages show the paper-record banner; /momentum-book lands on / |
| **Source** | README §116, §118 |

</details>

<details>
<summary><code>UI-05</code> <b>Active</b> — Pause entries, Stop &amp; close all and Go live each have their own busy state: Stop &amp; close all is disabled only by its own request.</summary>

Pause entries, Stop & close all and Go live each have their own busy state: Stop & close all is disabled only by its own request. Every dashboard request times out (10 s by default, 45 s for Stop & close all). The header's Live button and the Overview's Go live run the same warning, read at the click: the Dimaag Scorecard, the real Kite balance, F&O and the confidence bar.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Why** | A hung Pause or Go live request used to disable the kill switch (#233), and the header's Live skipped the Overview's warning (#234). |
| **Enforced in** | `frontend/src/useEngineControls.js:useEngineControls, goLiveMessage; frontend/src/api.js:apiFetch, useAction` |
| **How to check** | Against a mock backend whose /api/control/pause hangs: click Pause, then Stop & close all; Stop runs at once and Pause reports a timeout after 10 s |
| **Source** | README §119 |

</details>
